/* =======================================================================
   NHÁNH 1: NHIỆM VỤ NHẬN TỪ HỆ THỐNG QLNV (qlnv_task)
   ======================================================================= */
SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
    CAST(t.TaskId AS SIGNED)                                AS task_id,
    CAST(t.Status AS SIGNED)                                AS status,

    /* 2. TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 (ID & TÊN CẤP 2) */
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_truc_giao,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), MAX(d_assign_cap2.name)) AS truc_giao,
    t.DocCode                                               AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ & LÃNH ĐẠO */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    CAST(t.TargetUser AS SIGNED)                            AS id_lanh_dao,
    MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname)                          AS ten_lanh_dao,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ & PHÒNG THEO DÕI */
    t.TargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_cap.name),
        MAX(d_donvi.name)
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    NULL                                                    AS ten_phong_theo_doi,

    /* 5. CHUYÊN VIÊN THỰC HIỆN */
    CAST(NULL AS SIGNED)                                    AS id_chuyen_vien,
    NULL                                                    AS chuyen_vien,

    /* 6. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 7. PHÂN LOẠI 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
    CASE
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'

        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND t.ExpireDate >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND t.ExpireDate < CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 8. KẾT QUẢ & ĐỒNG BỘ */
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT rp.Content 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        t.Content
    )                                                       AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua,
    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          ) AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3), '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          ) AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          ) AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target 
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        OR (
            t.Status IN (3, 4)
            AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
        )
    )
    AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
    AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.1775%'
    AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'

/* Gom 1 dòng / 1 TaskId: chống nhân dòng do LEFT JOIN qlnv_user & department */
GROUP BY t.TaskId

UNION ALL

/* -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   NHÁNH 2: BẢNG datamart_hanoi.api_theodoinq_danh_sach_nhiem_vu_chi_tiet
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------- */
SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG */
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(nq.row_id, ''), 
            NULLIF(nq.source_row_id, ''),
            CRC32(CONCAT(COALESCE(nq.ma_nhiem_vu, ''), COALESCE(nq.ten_nhiem_vu, '')))
        ) AS SIGNED
    )                                                       AS task_id,
    CAST(NULL AS SIGNED)                                    AS status,

    /* 2. TRỤC GIAO */
    NULL                                                    AS id_truc_giao,
     'Trung ương'									          AS truc_giao,
    nq.van_ban_giao_nhiem_vu                                AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ & LÃNH ĐẠO */
    nq.ma_nhiem_vu                                          AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    nq.ten_nhiem_vu                                         AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    CAST(NULL AS SIGNED)                                    AS id_lanh_dao,
    NULL                                                    AS ten_lanh_dao,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ & PHÒNG THEO DÕI */
    NULL                                                    AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    nq.don_vi_chu_tri                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    NULL                                                    AS ten_phong_theo_doi,

    /* 5. CHUYÊN VIÊN */
    CAST(NULL AS SIGNED)                                    AS id_chuyen_vien,
    NULL                                                    AS chuyen_vien,

    /* 6. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN: PHÂN LOẠI RÕ TỪNG DẠNG CHUỖI */
    CASE 
        WHEN nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu IS NULL 
             OR TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu) = '' 
             OR nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu LIKE '1970%' 
             OR nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu LIKE '0000%'
        THEN NULL

        -- Dạng dd/mm/yyyy -> Giữ nguyên
        WHEN nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu LIKE '%/%'
        THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10)

        -- Dạng dd-mm-yyyy (ví dụ '05-01-2026', dấu gạch ngang ở vị trí thứ 3)
        WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 3, 1) = '-'
        THEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10), '-', '/')

        -- Dạng yyyy-mm-dd (ví dụ '2026-01-05', dấu gạch ngang ở vị trí thứ 5)
        WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 5, 1) = '-'
        THEN DATE_FORMAT(
            STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d'), 
            '%d/%m/%Y'
        )

        ELSE SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10)
    END                                                     AS ngay_giao,

    CASE 
        WHEN nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh IS NULL 
             OR TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh) = '' 
             OR nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh LIKE '1970%' 
             OR nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh LIKE '0000%'
        THEN NULL

        -- Dạng dd/mm/yyyy -> Giữ nguyên
        WHEN nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh LIKE '%/%'
        THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 1, 10)

        -- Dạng dd-mm-yyyy (ví dụ '05-01-2026', dấu gạch ngang ở vị trí thứ 3)
        WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 3, 1) = '-'
        THEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 1, 10), '-', '/')

        -- Dạng yyyy-mm-dd (ví dụ '2026-01-05', dấu gạch ngang ở vị trí thứ 5)
        WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 5, 1) = '-'
        THEN DATE_FORMAT(
            STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d'), 
            '%d/%m/%Y'
        )

        ELSE SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 1, 10)
    END                                                     AS han_xu_ly,

    NULL                                                    AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    NULL                                                    AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 7. TÌNH TRẠNG LẤY TỪ TRANG_THAI */
    nq.trang_thai                                           AS tinh_trang,

    /* 8. KẾT QUẢ THỰC HIỆN */
    COALESCE(NULLIF(nq.ket_qua_thuc_hien, ''), '—')         AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua,
    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

/* Mỗi row_id giữ 1 dòng = dòng có NGÀY GIAO MỚI NHẤT.
   MySQL 5.7 không có ROW_NUMBER(), nên dựng "khóa sắp xếp" <yyyymmdd><source_row_id>
   rồi JOIN với MAX(khóa) theo row_id -> chỉ dòng mới nhất khớp. */
FROM `datamart_hanoi`.`api_theodoinq_danh_sach_nhiem_vu_chi_tiet` nq

INNER JOIN (
    SELECT nq0.row_id                                       AS row_id,
           MAX(CONCAT(
                   CASE                                                 -- ngày giao -> yyyymmdd để so sánh chuỗi đúng thứ tự
                       WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 5, 1) = '-'                  -- yyyy-mm-dd
                       THEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10), '-', '')
                       WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 3, 1) IN ('/', '-')          -- dd/mm/yyyy hoặc dd-mm-yyyy
                       THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 7, 4), SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 4, 2), SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 2))
                       ELSE '00000000'                                  -- NULL/rỗng/hỏng -> xếp cuối
                   END,
                   LPAD(COALESCE(nq0.source_row_id, 0), 20, '0')        -- tie-break khi trùng ngày giao
               ))                            AS sort_key
    FROM `datamart_hanoi`.`api_theodoinq_danh_sach_nhiem_vu_chi_tiet` nq0
    WHERE nq0.ten_nhiem_vu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY nq0.row_id
) pick
    ON  pick.row_id   = nq.row_id
    AND pick.sort_key = CONCAT(
                            CASE                                                 -- ngày giao -> yyyymmdd để so sánh chuỗi đúng thứ tự
                                WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 5, 1) = '-'                  -- yyyy-mm-dd
                                THEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10), '-', '')
                                WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 3, 1) IN ('/', '-')          -- dd/mm/yyyy hoặc dd-mm-yyyy
                                THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 7, 4), SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 4, 2), SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 2))
                                ELSE '00000000'                                  -- NULL/rỗng/hỏng -> xếp cuối
                            END,
                            LPAD(COALESCE(nq.source_row_id, 0), 20, '0')        -- tie-break khi trùng ngày giao
                        )

WHERE nq.ten_nhiem_vu IS NOT NULL
group by nq.row_id;

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_lichsutiendo_nvnhan_pth_vpthanhuy` (
    `timeline_id`,
    `task_id`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,

    `nguoi_xu_ly_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_name`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name`,

    `nguoi_nhan_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_name`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name`,

    `role`,
    `action_type`,
    `ten_action_type`,

    `noi_dung`,
    `action_date`,
    `sync_date`
)


SELECT
    tl.TimelineId                                           AS timeline_id,
    tl.TaskId                                               AS task_id,
    MAX(t.Code)                                             AS ma_nhiem_vu,

    COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser)                      AS nguoi_xu_ly_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_action.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        CAST(COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser) AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_name,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(u_action.eGovUserPositionId),
        MAX(u_create.eGovUserPositionId)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_action.eGovUserPositionName), ''),
        NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserPositionName), '')
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name,

    tl.TargetUserId                                         AS nguoi_nhan_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        CAST(tl.TargetUserId AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_nhan_name,

    MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionId)                         AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,
    NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionName), '')           AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

    tl.Role                                                 AS role,
    tl.ActionType                                           AS action_type,

    /* Map Description từ Enum Notification */
    CASE tl.ActionType
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Giao nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Chỉnh sửa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Báo cáo % tiến độ'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Trả lại nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Gửi ý kiến xử lý'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Kết thúc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Chuyển xử lý'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 13 THEN 'Yêu cầu báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 14 THEN 'Gửi báo cáo'
        WHEN 15 THEN 'Xóa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 16 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 17 THEN 'Duyệt xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 18 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 19 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 20 THEN 'Từ chối xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 21 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 22 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 23 THEN 'Thu hồi xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 24 THEN 'Báo cáo lộ trình triển khai'
        WHEN 25 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 26 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 27 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 28 THEN 'Được tạo bởi AI bóc tách nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Khác'
    END                                                     AS ten_action_type,

    tl.Content                                              AS noi_dung,
    COALESCE(tl.ActionDate, tl.CreatedDate)                 AS action_date,
    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_timeline` tl

INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t
        ON t.TaskId = tl.TaskId

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_action
       ON u_action.eGovUserId = tl.UserId

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = tl.CreateUser

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = tl.TargetUserId

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        OR (
            t.Status IN (3, 4)
            AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
        )
    )
    /* LỌC THEO DẢI ĐƠN VỊ NHẬN 490.695 (VĂN PHÒNG THÀNH ỦY) */
    AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695%'

    /* LOẠI TRỪ 2 TRỤC GIAO KHÔNG TÍNH LÀ GIAO QUA: 490.1775 VÀ 490.698 */
    AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.1775%'
    AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'

/* GOM NHÓM THEO TIMELINEID ĐỂ ĐẢM BẢO DUY NHẤT KHÓA CHÍNH */
GROUP BY tl.TimelineId;

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_chitiet_nvnhan_pth_vpthanhuy` (
    `task_id`,
    `status`,
    `id_truc_giao`,
    `truc_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `chu_de`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_thuc_hien`,
    `id_nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `ngay_chap_nhan`,
    `ngay_xoa`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `ket_qua_thuc_hien`,
    `kho_khan_vuong_mac`,
    `de_xuat_kien_nghi`,
    `sync_date`
)



/* =======================================================================
   NHÁNH 1: NHIỆM VỤ NHẬN TỪ HỆ THỐNG QLNV (qlnv_task)
   ======================================================================= */
SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
    CAST(t.TaskId AS SIGNED)                                AS task_id,
    CAST(t.Status AS SIGNED)                                AS status,

    /* 2. TRỤC GIAO & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_truc_giao,
    MAX(d_assign_cap2.name)                                 AS truc_giao,
    t.DocCode                                               AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ, TIÊU ĐỀ & CHỦ ĐỀ */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.NameGroup, ''))     AS chu_de,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ & NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN */
    t.TargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_cap.name),
        MAX(d_donvi.name)
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    
    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_donvi.name),
        /* FALLBACK: task này không xác định được đơn vị thực hiện
           -> lấy đơn vị thực hiện từ nhiệm vụ GẦN NHẤT khác của cùng TargetUser */
        (
            SELECT COALESCE(
                       d_fb.name
                   )
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t_fb
            LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_fb
                   ON d_fb.id = CAST(
                        SUBSTRING_INDEX(t_fb.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED
                      )
                  AND d_fb.IsDelete = 0
            WHERE t.TargetUser > 0                    /* chặn TargetUser = 0 (hệ thống) */
              AND t_fb.TargetUser = t.TargetUser
              AND t_fb.TaskId <> t.TaskId
              AND t_fb.DeletedDate IS NULL
              AND COALESCE(
                      d_fb.name,
                      NULLIF(t_fb.ResponsibleUnit, ''),
                      NULLIF(t_fb.TargetOrganization, '')
                  ) IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY t_fb.CreatedDate DESC, t_fb.TaskId DESC
            LIMIT 1
        )
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,

    CAST(t.TargetUser AS SIGNED)                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
    MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname)                          AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

    /* Lãnh đạo ban phụ trách */
    CONCAT_WS(' · ',
        COALESCE(MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionName), NULLIF(t.ChargeUser, ''))
    )                                                       AS lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach,

    /* 5. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ApprovedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                 AS ngay_chap_nhan,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 6. PHÂN LOẠI 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
    CASE
        /* 1. Đã hoàn thành (đúng hạn hoặc quá hạn) */
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'

        /* 2. Thường xuyên (nhiệm vụ không có hạn) */
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        /* 3. Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn */
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

        /* 4. Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn */
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 7. CHI TIẾT TÌNH HÌNH & BÁO CÁO (Lấy bản ghi mới nhất) */
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT rp.Content 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        t.Content,
        '—'
    )                                                       AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT NULLIF(rp.Difficulty, '') 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS kho_khan_vuong_mac,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT NULLIF(rp.Suggestion, '') 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS de_xuat_kien_nghi,

    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* JOIN TÊN ĐƠN VỊ TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          ) AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN DANH MỤC PHÒNG BAN ĐƠN VỊ NHẬN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3), '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          ) AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          ) AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN USER NHẬN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target 
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    
    /* LOẠI BỎ CÁC TASK CHƯA XÁC ĐỊNH TÌNH TRẠNG */
    AND (
        t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        OR (
            t.Status IN (3, 4)
            AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
        )
    )

    /* LỌC THEO DẢI ĐƠN VỊ NHẬN 490.695 (VĂN PHÒNG THÀNH ỦY) */
    AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695%'

    /* LOẠI TRỪ 2 TRỤC GIAO KHÔNG TÍNH LÀ GIAO QUA: 490.1775 VÀ 490.698 */
    AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.1775%'
    AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'

/* Gom 1 dòng / 1 TaskId: chống nhân dòng do LEFT JOIN qlnv_user & department */
GROUP BY t.TaskId

UNION ALL

/* -----------------------------------------------------------------------
   NHÁNH 2: BẢNG datamart_hanoi.api_theodoinq_danh_sach_nhiem_vu_chi_tiet
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------- */
SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(nq.row_id, ''), 
            NULLIF(nq.source_row_id, ''),
            CRC32(CONCAT(COALESCE(nq.ma_nhiem_vu, ''), COALESCE(nq.ten_nhiem_vu, '')))
        ) AS SIGNED
    )                                                       AS task_id,
    CAST(NULL AS SIGNED)                                    AS status,

    /* 2. TRỤC GIAO & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    NULL                                                    AS id_truc_giao,
    'Trung ương'           AS truc_giao,
    nq.van_ban_giao_nhiem_vu                                AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ, TIÊU ĐỀ & CHỦ ĐỀ */
    nq.ma_nhiem_vu                                          AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    nq.ten_nhiem_vu                                         AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    'Chưa phân loại'                                        AS chu_de,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ & NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN */
    NULL                                                    AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    nq.don_vi_chu_tri                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    nq.don_vi_chu_tri                                       AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,

    CAST(NULL AS SIGNED)                                    AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
    NULL                                                    AS nguoi_thuc_hien,
    NULL                                                    AS lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach,

    /* 5. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN: PHÂN LOẠI RÕ TỪNG DẠNG CHUỖI */
    CASE 
        WHEN nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu IS NULL 
             OR TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu) = '' 
             OR nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu LIKE '1970%' 
             OR nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu LIKE '0000%'
        THEN NULL

        -- Dạng dd/mm/yyyy -> Giữ nguyên
        WHEN nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu LIKE '%/%'
        THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10)

        -- Dạng dd-mm-yyyy (dấu gạch ngang ở vị trí thứ 3)
        WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 3, 1) = '-'
        THEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10), '-', '/')

        -- Dạng yyyy-mm-dd (dấu gạch ngang ở vị trí thứ 5)
        WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 5, 1) = '-'
        THEN DATE_FORMAT(
            STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d'), 
            '%d/%m/%Y'
        )

        ELSE SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10)
    END                                                     AS ngay_giao,

    CASE 
        WHEN nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh IS NULL 
             OR TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh) = '' 
             OR nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh LIKE '1970%' 
             OR nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh LIKE '0000%'
        THEN NULL

        -- Dạng dd/mm/yyyy -> Giữ nguyên
        WHEN nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh LIKE '%/%'
        THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 1, 10)

        -- Dạng dd-mm-yyyy (dấu gạch ngang ở vị trí thứ 3)
        WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 3, 1) = '-'
        THEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 1, 10), '-', '/')

        -- Dạng yyyy-mm-dd (dấu gạch ngang ở vị trí thứ 5)
        WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 5, 1) = '-'
        THEN DATE_FORMAT(
            STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d'), 
            '%d/%m/%Y'
        )

        ELSE SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_han_hoan_thanh), 1, 10)
    END                                                     AS han_xu_ly,

    NULL                                                    AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    NULL                                                    AS ngay_chap_nhan,
    NULL                                                    AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 6. TÌNH TRẠNG LẤY TỪ TRANG_THAI */
    nq.trang_thai                                           AS tinh_trang,

    /* 7. KẾT QUẢ THỰC HIỆN (bảng nguồn không có khó khăn / đề xuất) */
    COALESCE(NULLIF(nq.ket_qua_thuc_hien, ''), '—')         AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,
    '—'                                                     AS kho_khan_vuong_mac,
    '—'                                                     AS de_xuat_kien_nghi,

    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

/* Mỗi row_id giữ 1 dòng = dòng có NGÀY GIAO MỚI NHẤT.
   MySQL 5.7 không có ROW_NUMBER(), nên dựng "khóa sắp xếp" <yyyymmdd><source_row_id>
   rồi JOIN với MAX(khóa) theo row_id -> chỉ dòng mới nhất khớp. */
FROM `datamart_hanoi`.`api_theodoinq_danh_sach_nhiem_vu_chi_tiet` nq

INNER JOIN (
    SELECT nq0.row_id                                       AS row_id,
           MAX(CONCAT(
                   CASE                                                 -- ngày giao -> yyyymmdd để so sánh chuỗi đúng thứ tự
                       WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 5, 1) = '-'                  -- yyyy-mm-dd
                       THEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10), '-', '')
                       WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 3, 1) IN ('/', '-')          -- dd/mm/yyyy hoặc dd-mm-yyyy
                       THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 7, 4), SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 4, 2), SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq0.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 2))
                       ELSE '00000000'                                  -- NULL/rỗng/hỏng -> xếp cuối
                   END,
                   LPAD(COALESCE(nq0.source_row_id, 0), 20, '0')        -- tie-break khi trùng ngày giao
               ))                            AS sort_key
    FROM `datamart_hanoi`.`api_theodoinq_danh_sach_nhiem_vu_chi_tiet` nq0
    WHERE nq0.ten_nhiem_vu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY nq0.row_id
) pick
    ON  pick.row_id   = nq.row_id
    AND pick.sort_key = CONCAT(
                            CASE                                                 -- ngày giao -> yyyymmdd để so sánh chuỗi đúng thứ tự
                                WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 5, 1) = '-'                  -- yyyy-mm-dd
                                THEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 10), '-', '')
                                WHEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 3, 1) IN ('/', '-')          -- dd/mm/yyyy hoặc dd-mm-yyyy
                                THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 7, 4), SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 4, 2), SUBSTRING(TRIM(nq.thoi_gian_giao_nhiem_vu), 1, 2))
                                ELSE '00000000'                                  -- NULL/rỗng/hỏng -> xếp cuối
                            END,
                            LPAD(COALESCE(nq.source_row_id, 0), 20, '0')        -- tie-break khi trùng ngày giao
                        )

WHERE nq.ten_nhiem_vu IS NOT NULL
group by nq.row_id;

Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

/* 11/11 real-time: READ COMMITTED để INSERT…SELECT đọc snapshot, không khóa S bảng nguồn */
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_cho_duyet_pth_vpthanhuy` (
    `task_id`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `id_van_ban_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `han_hoan_thanh`,
    `trang_thai`,
    `id_phong_ban_giao`,
    `phong_ban_giao`,
    `id_can_bo_giao`,
    `can_bo_giao`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `id_don_vi_thuc_hien`,
    `don_vi_thuc_hien`,
    `id_nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `tinh_hinh_ket_qua`,
    `sync_date`
)


SELECT
    /* =====================================================
       1. THÔNG TIN KHÓA & MÃ / TÊN NHIỆM VỤ
       ===================================================== */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,

    /* =====================================================
       2. VĂN BẢN GIAO & THỜI HẠN
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(t.ResolutionId, MAX(r.ResolutionId))           AS id_van_ban_giao,
    COALESCE(t.DocCode, MAX(r.DocCode))                     AS van_ban_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_hoan_thanh,

    /* =====================================================
       3. TRẠNG THÁI CHỜ PHÊ DUYỆT (TRONG HẠN / QUÁ HẠN)
       ===================================================== */
    CASE
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Chờ duyệt quá hạn'
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Chờ duyệt trong hạn'
        ELSE 'Chờ duyệt - không có hạn'
    END                                                     AS trang_thai,

    /* =====================================================
       4. PHÒNG BAN GIAO & CÁN BỘ GIAO (ID TRƯỚC TÊN)
       ===================================================== */
    -- TH1: Giao trực tiếp từ 490.695% -> lấy AssignDepartment
    -- TH2: Bên khác giao qua -> lấy DepartmentPath của CreateUser
    CASE 
        WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' THEN t.AssignDepartment
        ELSE MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath)
    END                                                     AS id_phong_ban_giao,

    CASE 
        WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), MAX(d_assign.name))
        ELSE MAX(d_create_dept.name)
    END                                                     AS phong_ban_giao,

    t.CreateUser                                            AS id_can_bo_giao,
    MAX(u_assign.eGovUserFullname)                          AS can_bo_giao,

    /* =====================================================
       5. ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ & ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN (ID TRƯỚC TÊN)
       ===================================================== */
    CASE 
        WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
        ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
    END                                                     AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.ResponsibleUnit, ''),
        NULLIF(t.TargetOrganization, ''),
        MAX(d_cap.name),
        MAX(d_donvi.name)
    )                                                       AS don_vi_chu_tri,

    t.TargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_thuc_hien,
    NULL                                                    AS don_vi_thuc_hien,

    /* =====================================================
       6. NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN (ID TRƯỚC TÊN)
       ===================================================== */
    t.TargetUser                                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
    MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname)                          AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

    /* =====================================================
       7. TÌNH HÌNH, KẾT QUẢ
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        MAX(rp_last.Content), 
        t.Content
    )                                                       AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua,

    /* Thời điểm đồng bộ */
    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* SUBQUERY LỌC NHIỆM VỤ CÓ BÁO CÁO CHỜ DUYỆT TỪ qlnv_report */
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t_sub 
            ON rp.TaskId = t_sub.TaskId
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND rp.Type IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
      AND rp.Status = 0
      AND t_sub.Status < 3
      AND t_sub.CreateUser = rp.ApprovedUser
    GROUP BY rp.TaskId
) rp_wait 
    ON rp_wait.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* NỘI DUNG BÁO CÁO GẦN NHẤT */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId, 
        rp.Content
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            TaskId, 
            MAX(CreatedDate) AS MaxCreatedDate
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report`
        WHERE DeletedDate IS NULL
        GROUP BY TaskId
    ) rp_max ON rp.TaskId = rp_max.TaskId AND rp.CreatedDate = rp_max.MaxCreatedDate
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
) rp_last ON rp_last.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* JOIN THÔNG TIN VĂN BẢN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
       ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
      AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN GIAO (TH1) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
       ON d_assign.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN CÁN BỘ TẠO TASK (TH2) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN CỦA CÁN BỘ TẠO TASK (TH2) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_create_dept
       ON d_create_dept.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_create_dept.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN CẤP ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ (CẤP 3/4) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
                END, '.', -1
            ) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                        ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
                    END, '.', -1
                ) AS UNSIGNED
            )
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN USER LẤY TÊN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
       ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 1: GIAO TRỰC TIẾP TỪ VĂN PHÒNG THÀNH ỦY 490.695% */
        t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'

        OR

        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 2: BÊN KHÁC GIAO QUA NHƯNG NGƯỜI DUYỆT BÁO CÁO THUỘC 490.695% */
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp_check
            INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_app
                    ON u_app.eGovUserId = rp_check.ApprovedUser
            WHERE rp_check.TaskId = t.TaskId
              AND rp_check.DeletedDate IS NULL
              AND u_app.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.695%'
        ) 
    )

GROUP BY t.TaskId;

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

File Size.name: File Size

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The number of FlowFiles to be transferred in each invocation

Data Format.name: Data Format
Data Format.description: Specifies whether the data should be Text or Binary

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile that is generated will be unique. If false, a random value will be generated and all FlowFiles will get the same content but this offers much higher throughput

generate-ff-custom-text.name: generate-ff-custom-text
generate-ff-custom-text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. Finally, if Expression Language is used, evaluation will be performed only once per batch of generated FlowFiles

mime-type.name: mime-type
mime-type.description: Specifies the value to set for the "mime.type" attribute.

relationships.description: FlowFiles that could not be updated are routed to this relationship

relationships.description: FlowFiles that have been successfully processed are routed to this relationship. This includes both FlowFiles that had text replaced and those that did not.

properties.Replacement Value:
/* 11/11 real-time: READ COMMITTED để INSERT…SELECT đọc snapshot, không khóa S bảng nguồn */
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nvgiao_pth_vpthanhuy` (
    `id_truc_giao`,
    `truc_giao`,
    `nhom_nhiem_vu`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `id_lanh_dao`,
    `ten_lanh_dao`,
    `id_chuyen_vien`,
    `chuyen_vien`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `ngay_xoa`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `tinh_hinh_ket_qua`,
    `ld_ubnd`,
    `ld_van_phong`,
    `phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi`,
    `chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi`,
    `task_id`,
    `status`,
    `sync_date`
)

SELECT
    /* 1. NHÓM NHIỆM VỤ / TRỤC GIAO */
    t.AssignDepartment                                     AS id_truc_giao,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), MAX(d_assign_cap2.name)) AS truc_giao,
    t.NameGroup                                            AS nhom_nhiem_vu,

    /* 2. MÃ NHIỆM VỤ & TÊN NHIỆM VỤ */
    t.Code                                                 AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                AS ten_nhiem_vu,

    /* 3. VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    t.DocCode                                              AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ (CHUẨN HÓA CẤP) */
    CASE
        WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1307%'
          OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310%'
          OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1841%'
        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
        ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
    END                                                    AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,

    COALESCE(MAX(d_chutri.name))                           AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,

    /* 5. LÃNH ĐẠO ĐƠN VỊ VÀ CHUYÊN VIÊN */
    CASE 
        WHEN t.TargetUser REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
        THEN CAST(t.TargetUser AS SIGNED) 
        ELSE NULL 
    END                                                    AS id_lanh_dao,
    MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname)                         AS ten_lanh_dao,
    NULL                                                   AS id_chuyen_vien,
    NULL                                                   AS chuyen_vien,

    /* 6. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                 AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')               AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                 AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 7. PHÂN LOẠI 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
    CASE
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'

        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND t.ExpireDate >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND t.ExpireDate < CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
    END                                                    AS tinh_trang,

    /* 8. TÌNH HÌNH, KẾT QUẢ THỰC HIỆN */
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT rp.Content 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        t.Content
    )                                                      AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua,

    /* 9. BỔ SUNG 4 CỘT THEO DÕI */
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255))                                AS ld_ubnd,
    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(255))                                AS ld_van_phong,
    NULLIF(MAX(d_create.name), '')                         AS phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi,
    NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserFullname), '')             AS chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi,

    /* 10. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & ĐỒNG BỘ */
    t.TaskId                                               AS task_id,
    t.Status                                               AS status,
    NOW()                                                  AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* JOIN TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 (Giữ nguyên d_assign_cap2.id để dùng Index) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL 
          END 
      AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ (Giữ nguyên d_chutri.id để dùng Index) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_chutri
       ON d_chutri.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE
                    WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1307%'
                      OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                      OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
                END, '.', -1
            ) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1307%'
                          OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                          OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                        ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
                    END, '.', -1
                ) AS UNSIGNED
            )
            ELSE NULL 
          END 
      AND d_chutri.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN USER NHẬN: Giữ bare u_target.eGovUserId để MySQL sử dụng Index B-Tree */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target 
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = CASE 
            WHEN t.TargetUser REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(t.TargetUser AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END

/* JOIN USER TẠO: Giữ bare u_create.eGovUserId để MySQL sử dụng Index B-Tree */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = CASE 
            WHEN t.CreateUser REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(t.CreateUser AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN NGƯỜI TẠO */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_create
       ON d_create.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL 
          END 
      AND d_create.IsDelete = 0

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        OR (
            t.Status IN (3, 4)
            AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
        )
    )
    AND t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
    AND COALESCE(t.TargetDepartment, '') NOT IN (
        '490.698.1307',
        '490.698.1310',
        '490.698.1841'
    )

GROUP BY t.TaskId;

/* 11/11 real-time: READ COMMITTED để INSERT…SELECT đọc snapshot, không khóa S bảng nguồn */
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_chitiet_nvgiao_pth_vpthanhuy` (
    `task_id`,
    `status`,
    `id_truc_giao`,
    `truc_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `chu_de`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_thuc_hien`,
    `id_nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `ngay_chap_nhan`,
    `ngay_xoa`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `ket_qua_thuc_hien`,
    `kho_khan_vuong_mac`,
    `de_xuat_kien_nghi`,
    `sync_date`
)
SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    t.Status                                                AS status,

    /* 2. NHÓM NHIỆM VỤ / TRỤC GIAO & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_truc_giao,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), MAX(d_assign_cap2.name)) AS truc_giao,
    t.DocCode                                               AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ, TIÊU ĐỀ & CHỦ ĐỀ */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.NameGroup, ''), 'Chưa phân loại')     AS chu_de,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ (CHUẨN HÓA CẤP) */
    CASE
        WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1307%'
          OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310%'
          OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1841%'
        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
        ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
    END                                                     AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,

    COALESCE(MAX(d_chutri.name))                            AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    COALESCE(MAX(d_donvi.name))                             AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,

    /* 5. NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN & LÃNH ĐẠO BAN PHỤ TRÁCH */
    t.TargetUser                                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
    MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname)                          AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

    CONCAT_WS(' · ',
        COALESCE(MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionName), NULLIF(t.ChargeUser, ''))
    )                                                       AS lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach,

    /* 6. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ApprovedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                 AS ngay_chap_nhan,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 7. PHÂN LOẠI 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
    CASE
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'

        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 8. BÁO CÁO MỚI NHẤT (LẤY TỪ 1 LẦN JOIN THAY VÌ 3 SUBQUERY LẶP) */
    COALESCE(rp_last.Content, t.Content, '—')               AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(rp_last.Difficulty, ''), '—')           AS kho_khan_vuong_mac,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(rp_last.Suggestion, ''), '—')           AS de_xuat_kien_nghi,

    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* 1. LẤY BÁO CÁO GẦN NHẤT: Thu hẹp phạm vi theo TaskId trước khi lấy nội dung */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId,
        rp.Content,
        rp.Difficulty,
        rp.Suggestion
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            TaskId,
            MAX(ReportId) AS MaxReportId
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report`
        WHERE DeletedDate IS NULL
        GROUP BY TaskId
    ) rp_max ON rp.TaskId = rp_max.TaskId AND rp.ReportId = rp_max.MaxReportId
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
) rp_last ON rp_last.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* 2. JOIN TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 (Kiểm tra chuỗi số an toàn trước khi ép kiểu) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL 
          END 
      AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

/* 3. JOIN ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ (Đã chuẩn hóa cấp) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_chutri
       ON d_chutri.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE
                    WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1307%'
                      OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                      OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
                END, '.', -1
            ) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                    CASE
                        WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1307%'
                          OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                          OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                        ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
                    END, '.', -1
                ) AS UNSIGNED
            )
            ELSE NULL 
          END 
      AND d_chutri.IsDelete = 0

/* 4. JOIN ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN TRỰC TIẾP */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL 
          END 
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* 5. JOIN USER NHẬN: Giữ bare u_target.eGovUserId để tối ưu Index */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target 
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = CASE 
            WHEN t.TargetUser REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(t.TargetUser AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        OR (
            t.Status IN (3, 4)
            AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
        )
    )
    AND t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
    AND COALESCE(t.TargetDepartment, '') NOT IN (
        '490.698.1307',
        '490.698.1310',
        '490.698.1841'
    )

GROUP BY t.TaskId;

    `year_key`,
    `resolution_id`,
    `resolution_group_id`,
    `compendium`,
    `doc_code`,
    `kieu_van_ban`,
    `linh_vuc`,
    `ngay_van_ban`,
    `co_quan_ban_hanh`,
    `loai_cap_cha`,
    `loai_cap`,
    `id_don_vi_cap_tren`,
    `id_don_vi`,
    `don_vi`,
    `ten_viet_tat`,

SELECT
    /* =====================================================
       CHIỀU THỜI GIAN
       ===================================================== */

    /* =====================================================
       VĂN BẢN / NGHỊ QUYẾT
       ===================================================== */
    r.ResolutionId                                      AS resolution_id,
    r.ResolutionGroupId                                 AS resolution_group_id,
    r.Compendium                                        AS compendium,
    r.DocCode                                           AS doc_code,

    /* =====================================================
       KIỂU VĂN BẢN / LĨNH VỰC
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(NULLIF(rg.Name, ''))                       AS kieu_van_ban,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(s.SectorName, '')   )               AS linh_vuc,

    /* =====================================================
       NGÀY VĂN BẢN (dd/mm/yyyy)
       ===================================================== */
    DATE_FORMAT(r.StartDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_van_ban,

    /* =====================================================
       CƠ QUAN BAN HÀNH
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(r.AssignOrganizationName, '')
    )                                                   AS co_quan_ban_hanh,

    /* =====================================================
       CẤP ĐƠN VỊ TỪ DepartmentPath CỦA NGƯỜI TẠO (u.DepartmentPath)
       ===================================================== */
    d_capcha.name                                       AS loai_cap_cha,
    d_cap.name                                          AS loai_cap,

    /* ID Đơn vị cấp trên (segment kế cuối của path người tạo) */
    CAST(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', -2),
            '.',
            1
        ) AS UNSIGNED
    )                                                   AS id_don_vi_cap_tren,

    /* ID Đơn vị trực tiếp: Cấp 5 lùi về lấy ID cấp 4, còn lại lấy cấp cuối */
    CAST(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
            CASE 
                WHEN (LENGTH(u.DepartmentPath) - LENGTH(REPLACE(u.DepartmentPath, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 4)
                ELSE u.DepartmentPath 
            END,
            '.',
            -1
        ) AS UNSIGNED
    )                                                   AS id_don_vi,

    /* Tên đơn vị và tên viết tắt (Tự động ăn theo cấp 4 khi là cấp 5) */
    d_donvi.name                                        AS don_vi,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d_donvi.shortname, ''), d_donvi.name) AS ten_viet_tat,

    /* =====================================================
       NGƯỜI TẠO VĂN BẢN (Từ qlnv_user theo r.CreateUser)
       ===================================================== */
    r.CreateUser                                        AS nguoi_tao_id,
    u.UserName                                          AS nguoi_tao_tai_khoan,
    u.eGovUserFullname                                  AS nguoi_tao_ten,

    /* =====================================================
       SỐ NHIỆM VỤ GẮN VỚI VĂN BẢN (ĐẾM TRỰC TIẾP TỪ qlnv_task)
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(tc.so_nhiem_vu, 0)                         AS so_nhiem_vu,

    /* Thời điểm đồng bộ */
    NOW()                                               AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r

/* Nhóm / Kiểu văn bản */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution_group` rg
       ON rg.ResolutionGroupId = r.ResolutionGroupId
      AND rg.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* Lĩnh vực (Chỉ cần IS NULL vì DeletedDate là kiểu DATETIME) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_sector` s
       ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
      AND s.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* Thông tin tài khoản người tạo văn bản */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u
       ON u.eGovUserId = r.CreateUser

/* Cấp cha (segment 2 từ DepartmentPath của người tạo) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_capcha
       ON d_capcha.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 2), '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          )
      AND d_capcha.IsDelete = 0

/* Cấp (segment 3 từ DepartmentPath của người tạo) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 3), '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          )
      AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

/* Đơn vị trực tiếp: Cấp 5 lùi về Map với danh mục Cấp 4 */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN (LENGTH(u.DepartmentPath) - LENGTH(REPLACE(u.DepartmentPath, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.DepartmentPath, '.', 4)
                    ELSE u.DepartmentPath 
                END,
                '.',
                -1
            ) AS UNSIGNED
          )
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* =========================================================
   SUBQUERY: ĐẾM NHIỆM VỤ THEO ResolutionId VÀ LỌC TÌNH TRẠNG XÁC ĐỊNH
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        t.ResolutionId,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.TaskId) AS so_nhiem_vu
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t
    WHERE t.ResolutionId IS NOT NULL 
      AND t.ResolutionId > 0
      AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND t.Status != 5  /* Bỏ qua nhiệm vụ thu hồi */
      /* Chỉ lấy nhiệm vụ có tình trạng xác định rõ ràng */
      AND (
          t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
          OR (
              t.Status IN (3, 4) 
              AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
          )
      )
    GROUP BY
        t.ResolutionId
) tc
    ON tc.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId

WHERE
    r.DeletedDate IS NULL
    /* Lọc theo cây phân cấp đơn vị của người tạo văn bản (Văn phòng Thành ủy) */
    AND u.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.695.701%';

Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile that is generated will be unique. If false, a random value will be generated and all FlowFiles will get the same content but this offers much higher throughput

generate-ff-custom-text.name: generate-ff-custom-text
generate-ff-custom-text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. Finally, if Expression Language is used, evaluation will be performed only once per batch of generated FlowFiles

mime-type.name: mime-type

relationships.description: FlowFiles that could not be updated are routed to this relationship

relationships.description: FlowFiles that have been successfully processed are routed to this relationship. This includes both FlowFiles that had text replaced and those that did not.

properties.Replacement Value:
/* 11/11 real-time: READ COMMITTED để INSERT…SELECT đọc snapshot, không khóa S bảng nguồn */
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_lichsutiendo_nvchoduyet_pth_vpthanhuy` (
    `timeline_id`,
    `task_id`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,

    `nguoi_xu_ly_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_name`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name`,

    `nguoi_nhan_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_name`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name`,

    `role`,
    `action_type`,
    `ten_action_type`,

    `noi_dung`,
    `action_date`,
    `sync_date`
)

SELECT
    tl.TimelineId                                           AS timeline_id,
    tl.TaskId                                               AS task_id,
    MAX(t.Code)                                             AS ma_nhiem_vu,

    /* 1. NGƯỜI XỬ LÝ */
    COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser)                      AS nguoi_xu_ly_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_action.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        CAST(COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser) AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_name,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(u_action.eGovUserPositionId),
        MAX(u_create.eGovUserPositionId)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_action.eGovUserPositionName), ''),
        NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserPositionName), '')
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name,

    /* 2. NGƯỜI NHẬN */
    tl.TargetUserId                                         AS nguoi_nhan_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        CAST(tl.TargetUserId AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_nhan_name,

    MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionId)                         AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,
    NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionName), '')           AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

    /* 3. LOẠI HÀNH ĐỘNG & NỘI DUNG */
    tl.Role                                                 AS role,
    tl.ActionType                                           AS action_type,

    /* Map Description từ Enum Notification */
    CASE tl.ActionType
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Giao nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Chỉnh sửa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Báo cáo % tiến độ'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Trả lại nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Gửi ý kiến xử lý'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Kết thúc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Chuyển xử lý'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 13 THEN 'Yêu cầu báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 14 THEN 'Gửi báo cáo'
        WHEN 15 THEN 'Xóa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 16 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 17 THEN 'Duyệt xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 18 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 19 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 20 THEN 'Từ chối xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 21 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 22 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 23 THEN 'Thu hồi xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 24 THEN 'Báo cáo lộ trình triển khai'
        WHEN 25 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 26 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 27 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 28 THEN 'Được tạo bởi AI bóc tách nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Khác'
    END                                                     AS ten_action_type,

    tl.Content                                              AS noi_dung,
    COALESCE(tl.ActionDate, tl.CreatedDate)                 AS action_date,
    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_timeline` tl

/* JOIN BẢNG NHIỆM VỤ GỐC */
INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t
        ON t.TaskId = tl.TaskId

/* SUBQUERY LỌC CÁC TASK ĐANG CÓ BÁO CÁO CHỜ DUYỆT */
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t_sub 
            ON rp.TaskId = t_sub.TaskId
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND rp.Type IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
      AND rp.Status = 0
      AND t_sub.Status < 3
      AND t_sub.CreateUser = rp.ApprovedUser
    GROUP BY rp.TaskId
) rp_wait 
    ON rp_wait.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* JOIN USER THỰC HIỆN ACTION */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_action
       ON u_action.eGovUserId = tl.UserId

/* JOIN USER TẠO TIMELINE (FALLBACK KHI tl.UserId NULL) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = tl.CreateUser

/* JOIN USER NHẬN TIMELINE */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = tl.TargetUserId

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 1: GIAO TRỰC TIẾP TỪ VĂN PHÒNG THÀNH ỦY 490.695% */
        t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'

        OR

        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 2: BÊN KHÁC GIAO QUA NHƯNG NGƯỜI DUYỆT BÁO CÁO THUỘC 490.695% */
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp_check
            INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_app
                    ON u_app.eGovUserId = rp_check.ApprovedUser
            WHERE rp_check.TaskId = t.TaskId
              AND rp_check.DeletedDate IS NULL
              AND u_app.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.695%'
        ) 
    )

/* GOM NHÓM THEO TIMELINEID KHỬ TRÙNG LẶP TUYỆT ĐỐI */
GROUP BY tl.TimelineId;
