/* 11/11 real-time: READ COMMITTED để INSERT…SELECT đọc snapshot, không khóa S bảng nguồn */
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_chitiet_nvchoduyet_pth_vpthanhuy` (
    `task_id`,
    `status`,
    `id_truc_giao`,
    `truc_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `chu_de`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_thuc_hien`,
    `id_nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `ngay_chap_nhan`,
    `ngay_xoa`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `ket_qua_thuc_hien`,
    `kho_khan_vuong_mac`,
    `de_xuat_kien_nghi`,
    `sync_date`
)


SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    t.Status                                                AS status,

    /* 2. NHÓM NHIỆM VỤ / TRỤC GIAO & VĂN BẢN GIAO 
       - TH1: Giao trực tiếp từ 490.695% -> lấy AssignDepartment
       - TH2: Bên khác giao qua -> lấy DepartmentPath của CreateUser */
    CASE 
        WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' THEN t.AssignDepartment
        ELSE MAX(u_create.DepartmentPath)
    END                                                     AS id_truc_giao,

    CASE 
        WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), MAX(d_assign.name))
        ELSE MAX(d_create_dept.name)
    END                                                     AS truc_giao,

    COALESCE(t.DocCode, MAX(r.DocCode))                     AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ, TIÊU ĐỀ & CHỦ ĐỀ */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.NameGroup, ''), 'Chưa phân loại')     AS chu_de,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ (LÙI VỀ CẤP 4 NẾU CÓ >= 4 DẤU CHẤM) */
    /* Nếu không suy được đơn vị chủ trì -> lùi về phòng ban của t.TargetUser */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
            CASE 
                WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
            END, ''),
        MAX(d_target_dept.departmentpath)
    )                                                       AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,

    /* Nếu không suy được đơn vị chủ trì -> lùi về phòng ban của t.TargetUser */
    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_cap.name),
        MAX(d_donvi.name),
        MAX(d_target_dept.name)
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,

    /* LẤY DỮ LIỆU GIỐNG DON_VI_CHU_TRI */
    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_cap.name),
        MAX(d_donvi.name)
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,

    /* 5. NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN & LÃNH ĐẠO BAN PHỤ TRÁCH */
    t.TargetUser                                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
    MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname)                          AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

    MAX(u_assign.eGovUserFullname)                          AS lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach,

    /* 6. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ApprovedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                 AS ngay_chap_nhan,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 7. PHÂN LOẠI 3 TRẠNG THÁI CHỜ DUYỆT */
    CASE
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Chờ duyệt quá hạn'
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Chờ duyệt trong hạn'
        ELSE 'Chờ duyệt - không có hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 8. CHI TIẾT TÌNH HÌNH & BÁO CÁO (Lấy bản ghi báo cáo mới nhất) */
    COALESCE(
        MAX(rp_last.Content), 
        t.Content,
        '—'
    )                                                       AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(rp_last.Difficulty), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS kho_khan_vuong_mac,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(rp_last.Suggestion), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS de_xuat_kien_nghi,

    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* SUBQUERY LỌC NHIỆM VỤ CÓ BÁO CÁO CHỜ DUYỆT TỪ qlnv_report */
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t_sub 
            ON rp.TaskId = t_sub.TaskId
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND rp.Type IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
      AND rp.Status = 0
      AND t_sub.Status < 3
      AND t_sub.CreateUser = rp.ApprovedUser
    GROUP BY rp.TaskId
) rp_wait 
    ON rp_wait.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* NỘI DUNG BÁO CÁO GẦN NHẤT (Content, Difficulty, Suggestion) */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        rp.TaskId, 
        rp.Content,
        NULLIF(rp.Difficulty, '') AS Difficulty,
        NULLIF(rp.Suggestion, '') AS Suggestion
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT 
            TaskId, 
            MAX(CreatedDate) AS MaxCreatedDate
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report`
        WHERE DeletedDate IS NULL
        GROUP BY TaskId
    ) rp_max ON rp.TaskId = rp_max.TaskId AND rp.CreatedDate = rp_max.MaxCreatedDate
    WHERE rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
) rp_last ON rp_last.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* JOIN THÔNG TIN VĂN BẢN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
       ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
      AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN GIAO (TH1) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
       ON d_assign.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN CÁN BỘ TẠO TASK (TH2) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN CỦA CÁN BỘ TẠO TASK (TH2) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_create_dept
       ON d_create_dept.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_create_dept.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN CẤP ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ (CẤP 3/4) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
                END, '.', -1
            ) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                    CASE 
                        WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                        ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
                    END, '.', -1
                ) AS UNSIGNED
            )
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CASE 
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' 
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED) 
            ELSE NULL 
          END
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN USER LẤY TÊN (CÁN BỘ GIAO VÀ NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
       ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

/* JOIN PHÒNG BAN CỦA NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN (t.TargetUser)
   -> fallback khi không suy được đơn vị thực hiện từ t.TargetDepartment */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_target_dept
       ON d_target_dept.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_target.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_target.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_target_dept.IsDelete = 0

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 1: GIAO TRỰC TIẾP TỪ VĂN PHÒNG THÀNH ỦY 490.695% */
        t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'

        OR

        /* TRƯỜNG HỢP 2: BÊN KHÁC GIAO QUA NHƯNG NGƯỜI DUYỆT BÁO CÁO THUỘC 490.695% */
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp_check
            INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_app
                    ON u_app.eGovUserId = rp_check.ApprovedUser
            WHERE rp_check.TaskId = t.TaskId
              AND rp_check.DeletedDate IS NULL
              AND u_app.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.695%'
        ) 
    )

GROUP BY t.TaskId;

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_lichsutiendo_nvgiao_pth_vpthanhuy` (
    `timeline_id`,
    `task_id`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_name`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name`,
    `nguoi_nhan_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_name`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name`,
    `role`,
    `action_type`,
    `ten_action_type`,
    `noi_dung`,
    `action_date`,
    `sync_date`
)
SELECT
    tl.TimelineId                                           AS timeline_id,
    tl.TaskId                                               AS task_id,
    MAX(t.Code)                                             AS ma_nhiem_vu,

    COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser)                      AS nguoi_xu_ly_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_action.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        CAST(COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser) AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_name,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(u_action.eGovUserPositionId),
        MAX(u_create.eGovUserPositionId)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_action.eGovUserPositionName), ''),
        NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserPositionName), '')
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name,

    tl.TargetUserId                                         AS nguoi_nhan_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        CAST(tl.TargetUserId AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_nhan_name,

    MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionId)                         AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,
    NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionName), '')           AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

    tl.Role                                                 AS role,
    tl.ActionType                                           AS action_type,

    /* Map Description từ Enum Notification */
    CASE tl.ActionType
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Giao nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Chỉnh sửa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Báo cáo % tiến độ'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Trả lại nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Gửi ý kiến xử lý'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Kết thúc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Chuyển xử lý'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 13 THEN 'Yêu cầu báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 14 THEN 'Gửi báo cáo'
        WHEN 15 THEN 'Xóa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 16 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 17 THEN 'Duyệt xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 18 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 19 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 20 THEN 'Từ chối xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 21 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 22 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 23 THEN 'Thu hồi xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 24 THEN 'Báo cáo lộ trình triển khai'
        WHEN 25 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 26 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 27 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 28 THEN 'Được tạo bởi AI bóc tách nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Khác'
    END                                                     AS ten_action_type,

    tl.Content                                              AS noi_dung,
    COALESCE(tl.ActionDate, tl.CreatedDate)                 AS action_date,
    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_timeline` tl

INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t
        ON t.TaskId = tl.TaskId

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_action
       ON u_action.eGovUserId = tl.UserId

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = tl.CreateUser

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = tl.TargetUserId

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        OR (
            t.Status IN (3, 4)
            AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
        )
    )

    /* ĐIỀU KIỆN ĐƠN VỊ GIAO CHÍNH XÁC 490.695 (VĂN PHÒNG THÀNH ỦY) */
    AND t.AssignDepartment = '490.695'

    /* LOẠI 3 NODE TỔNG HỢP "CÁC SỞ NGÀNH" (chung chung, không phải đơn vị thật).
       NOT IN => chỉ loại đúng 3 node này, VẪN GIỮ các đơn vị con bên dưới. */
    AND COALESCE(t.TargetDepartment, '') NOT IN (
        '490.698.1307',
        '490.698.1310',
        '490.698.1841'
    )

/* GOM NHÓM THEO TIMELINEID KHỬ TRÙNG LẶP TUYỆT ĐỐI */
GROUP BY tl.TimelineId;

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_thongke_nhanh_nv_vpthanhuy` (
    `task_id`,
    `chieu`,
    `id_don_vi`,
    `ten_don_vi`,
    `id_truc`,
    `ten_truc`,
    `cap`,
    `thu_tu`,
    `so_tai_khoan_cap`,
    `so_da_dang_nhap`,
    `id_don_vi_doi_ung`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `can_cu`,
    `linh_vuc`,
    `id_chuyen_vien`,
    `chuyen_vien`,
    `status`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `sync_date`
)

/* =======================================================================
   CHIỀU NHẬN — đơn vị = TargetDepartment
   ======================================================================= */
SELECT
    CAST(t.TaskId AS SIGNED)                                AS task_id,
    'nhan'                                                  AS chieu,

    t.TargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.name, ''), t.TargetDepartment)        AS ten_don_vi,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_truc,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d_truc.name, ''),
             SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 2))   AS ten_truc,

    LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment)
        - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', '')) + 1  AS cap,

    /* Khóa sắp xếp: pad từng đoạn về 6 ký tự để đơn vị anh em xếp đúng thứ tự
       SỐ (không thì '1558' đứng trước '999'), con luôn nằm ngay dưới cha */
    CONCAT(
        LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 1), 6, '0'),
        '.',
        LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1), 6, '0'),
        CASE WHEN LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', '')) + 1 >= 3
             THEN CONCAT('.', LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3), '.', -1), 6, '0'))
             ELSE '' END,
        CASE WHEN LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', '')) + 1 >= 4
             THEN CONCAT('.', LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4), '.', -1), 6, '0'))
             ELSE '' END
    )                                                       AS thu_tu,

    COALESCE(MAX(tk.so_tai_khoan_cap), 0)                   AS so_tai_khoan_cap,
    MAX(tk.so_da_dang_nhap)                                 AS so_da_dang_nhap,

    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_doi_ung,

    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.DocCode, '')
    )                                                       AS van_ban_giao,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.Compendium, '')
    )                                                       AS can_cu,

    /* Sector là cột "Lĩnh vực"; rỗng thì lấy tạm NameGroup */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.Sector, ''),
        NULLIF(t.NameGroup, '')
    )                                                       AS linh_vuc,

    /* Chuyên viên = người thực hiện (TargetUser); tra không ra thì lấy
       ChargeUser (cột text tên người phụ trách) */
    CAST(t.TargetUser AS SIGNED)                            AS id_chuyen_vien,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        NULLIF(t.ChargeUser, '')
    )                                                       AS chuyen_vien,

    CAST(t.Status AS SIGNED)                                AS status,

    DATE(t.StartedDate)                                     AS ngay_giao,
    DATE(t.ExpireDate)                                      AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate))         AS ngay_hoan_thanh,

    /* 5 TÌNH TRẠNG RỜI NHAU — thứ tự WHEN quan trọng */
    CASE
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
        THEN 'HT đúng hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'HT quá hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'ĐTH trong hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) <  CURDATE()
        THEN 'ĐTH quá hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* TÊN ĐƠN VỊ — join department.id = ĐOẠN CUỐI của mã.
   REGEXP chặn CAST lỗi khi đoạn cuối không phải số.
   Tra không ra thì lấy chính mã làm tên, để không mất dòng. */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d
       ON d.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      /* COALESCE: IsDelete NULL thì `= 0` trả NULL -> mất tên */
      AND COALESCE(d.IsDelete, 0) = 0

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_truc
       ON d_truc.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND COALESCE(d_truc.IsDelete, 0) = 0

/* JOIN USER THỰC HIỆN (chuyên viên) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

/* TÀI KHOẢN THUỘC ĐƠN VỊ — gộp sẵn theo qlnv_user.DepartmentPath */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        u.DepartmentPath                                    AS ma_don_vi,
        COUNT(DISTINCT u.eGovUserId)                        AS so_tai_khoan_cap,
        NULL                                                AS so_da_dang_nhap
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u
    WHERE NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, '') IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
) tk
    ON tk.ma_don_vi = t.TargetDepartment

WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
  AND t.Status <> 5
  AND NULLIF(t.TargetDepartment, '') IS NOT NULL

  /* Chỉ lấy nhiệm vụ có tình trạng xác định rõ ràng */
  AND (
      t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
      OR (
          t.Status IN (3, 4)
          AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
      )
  )

  /* PHẠM VI: nhiệm vụ có liên quan Thành ủy ở BẤT KỲ đầu nào */
  AND (
      t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
      OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
  )

  /* LOẠI TRỪ 2 TRỤC GIAO KHÔNG TÍNH LÀ GIAO QUA — giống nv_nhan.
     Lọc theo AssignDepartment nên CHỈ chặn chiều VÀO Thành ủy. */
  AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.1775%'
  AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'

/* Gom 1 dòng / 1 TaskId: chống nhân dòng do LEFT JOIN department */
GROUP BY t.TaskId

UNION ALL

/* =======================================================================
   CHIỀU GIAO — đơn vị = AssignDepartment
   ======================================================================= */
SELECT
    CAST(t.TaskId AS SIGNED)                                AS task_id,
    'giao'                                                  AS chieu,

    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.name, ''), t.AssignDepartment)        AS ten_don_vi,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_truc,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d_truc.name, ''),
             SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2))   AS ten_truc,

    LENGTH(t.AssignDepartment)
        - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.AssignDepartment, '.', '')) + 1  AS cap,

    CONCAT(
        LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 1), 6, '0'),
        '.',
        LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1), 6, '0'),
        CASE WHEN LENGTH(t.AssignDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.AssignDepartment, '.', '')) + 1 >= 3
             THEN CONCAT('.', LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 3), '.', -1), 6, '0'))
             ELSE '' END,
        CASE WHEN LENGTH(t.AssignDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.AssignDepartment, '.', '')) + 1 >= 4
             THEN CONCAT('.', LPAD(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 4), '.', -1), 6, '0'))
             ELSE '' END
    )                                                       AS thu_tu,

    COALESCE(MAX(tk.so_tai_khoan_cap), 0)                   AS so_tai_khoan_cap,
    MAX(tk.so_da_dang_nhap)                                 AS so_da_dang_nhap,

    t.TargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_doi_ung,

    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.DocCode, '')
    )                                                       AS van_ban_giao,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.Compendium, '')
    )                                                       AS can_cu,

    /* Sector là cột "Lĩnh vực"; rỗng thì lấy tạm NameGroup */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.Sector, ''),
        NULLIF(t.NameGroup, '')
    )                                                       AS linh_vuc,

    /* Chuyên viên = người thực hiện (TargetUser); tra không ra thì lấy
       ChargeUser (cột text tên người phụ trách) */
    CAST(t.TargetUser AS SIGNED)                            AS id_chuyen_vien,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        NULLIF(t.ChargeUser, '')
    )                                                       AS chuyen_vien,

    CAST(t.Status AS SIGNED)                                AS status,

    DATE(t.StartedDate)                                     AS ngay_giao,
    DATE(t.ExpireDate)                                      AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate))         AS ngay_hoan_thanh,

    CASE
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
        THEN 'HT đúng hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'HT quá hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'ĐTH trong hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) <  CURDATE()
        THEN 'ĐTH quá hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d
       ON d.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND COALESCE(d.IsDelete, 0) = 0

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_truc
       ON d_truc.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND COALESCE(d_truc.IsDelete, 0) = 0

/* JOIN USER THỰC HIỆN (chuyên viên) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

/* TÀI KHOẢN THUỘC ĐƠN VỊ — gộp sẵn theo qlnv_user.DepartmentPath */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        u.DepartmentPath                                    AS ma_don_vi,
        COUNT(DISTINCT u.eGovUserId)                        AS so_tai_khoan_cap,
        NULL                                                AS so_da_dang_nhap
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u
    WHERE NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, '') IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
) tk
    ON tk.ma_don_vi = t.AssignDepartment

WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
  AND t.Status <> 5
  AND NULLIF(t.AssignDepartment, '') IS NOT NULL

  AND (
      t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
      OR (
          t.Status IN (3, 4)
          AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
      )
  )

  AND (
      t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
      OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
  )

  /* LOẠI 3 NODE TỔNG HỢP "CÁC SỞ NGÀNH" (chung chung, không phải đơn vị thật).
     NOT IN => chỉ loại đúng 3 node này, VẪN GIỮ đơn vị con. */
  AND COALESCE(t.TargetDepartment, '') NOT IN (
      '490.698.1307',
      '490.698.1310',
      '490.698.1841'
  )

GROUP BY t.TaskId;

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.

Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. /* 11/11 real-time: READ COMMITTED để INSERT…SELECT đọc snapshot, không khóa S bảng nguồn */
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_thongke_nhanh_chitiet_nv_vpthanhuy` (
    `task_id`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `can_cu`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `linh_vuc`,
    `id_chuyen_vien`,
    `chuyen_vien`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `status`,
    `sync_date`
)

SELECT
    CAST(t.TaskId AS SIGNED)                                AS task_id,

    /* 1. NHIỆM VỤ & VĂN BẢN CĂN CỨ */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.DocCode, '')
    )                                                       AS van_ban_giao,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.Compendium, '')
    )                                                       AS can_cu,

    /* 2. ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ — PHẢI dùng đúng công thức của qlnv_thongke_nhanh_task
          (department.name theo đoạn cuối của mã, tra không ra thì lấy chính mã)
          thì `ten_don_vi_chu_tri` ở đây mới khớp `ten_don_vi` bên đó.
          KHÔNG lấy ResponsibleUnit/TargetOrganization như file nv_nhan. */
    t.TargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(d.name), ''), t.TargetDepartment)   AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,

    /* 3. LĨNH VỰC — Sector là cột "Lĩnh vực"; rỗng thì lấy tạm NameGroup */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.Sector, ''),
        NULLIF(t.NameGroup, '')
    )                                                       AS linh_vuc,

    /* 4. CHUYÊN VIÊN = người thực hiện (TargetUser); tra không ra thì lấy
          ChargeUser (cột text tên người phụ trách) */
    CAST(t.TargetUser AS SIGNED)                            AS id_chuyen_vien,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        NULLIF(t.ChargeUser, '')
    )                                                       AS chuyen_vien,

    /* 5. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE(t.StartedDate)                                     AS ngay_giao,
    DATE(t.ExpireDate)                                      AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate))         AS ngay_hoan_thanh,

    /* 6. TÌNH TRẠNG — 5 giá trị RỜI NHAU, thứ tự WHEN quan trọng */
    CASE
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
        THEN 'HT đúng hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'HT quá hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'ĐTH trong hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) <  CURDATE()
        THEN 'ĐTH quá hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    CAST(t.Status AS SIGNED)                                AS status,
    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* TÊN ĐƠN VỊ — join department.id = ĐOẠN CUỐI của mã, giống hệt bảng task.
   REGEXP chặn CAST lỗi khi đoạn cuối không phải số. */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d
       ON d.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      /* COALESCE: IsDelete NULL thì `= 0` trả NULL -> mất tên */
      AND COALESCE(d.IsDelete, 0) = 0

/* JOIN USER THỰC HIỆN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
  AND t.Status <> 5
  AND NULLIF(t.TargetDepartment, '') IS NOT NULL

  /* Chỉ lấy nhiệm vụ có tình trạng xác định rõ ràng */
  AND (
      t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
      OR (
          t.Status IN (3, 4)
          AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)
      )
  )

  /* PHẠM VI: nhiệm vụ có liên quan Thành ủy ở BẤT KỲ đầu nào */
  AND (
      t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
      OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695%'
  )

  /* LOẠI TRỪ 2 TRỤC GIAO KHÔNG TÍNH LÀ GIAO QUA — giống nv_nhan */
  AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.1775%'
  AND COALESCE(t.AssignDepartment, '') NOT LIKE '490.698%'

/* Gom 1 dòng / 1 TaskId: chống nhân dòng do LEFT JOIN qlnv_user & department */
GROUP BY t.TaskId;

/* 11/11 real-time: READ COMMITTED để INSERT…SELECT đọc snapshot, không khóa S bảng nguồn */
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tientrinhxuly_kdnv_sontay` (
    `timeline_id`,
    `task_id`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,

    `nguoi_xu_ly_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_name`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name`,

    `nguoi_nhan_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_name`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name`,

    `role`,
    `action_type`,
    `ten_action_type`,

    `noi_dung`,
    `action_date`,
    `sync_date`
)
SELECT
    tl.TimelineId                                           AS timeline_id,
    tl.TaskId                                               AS task_id,
    MAX(t.Code)                                             AS ma_nhiem_vu,

    COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser)                      AS nguoi_xu_ly_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_action.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        CAST(COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser) AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_name,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(u_action.eGovUserPositionId),
        MAX(u_create.eGovUserPositionId)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_action.eGovUserPositionName), ''),
        NULLIF(MAX(u_create.eGovUserPositionName), '')
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name,

    tl.TargetUserId                                         AS nguoi_nhan_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname), ''),
        CAST(tl.TargetUserId AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_nhan_name,

    MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionId)                        AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,
    NULLIF(MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionName), '')          AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

    tl.Role                                                 AS role,
    tl.ActionType                                           AS action_type,

    /* Map Description từ Enum Notification */
    CASE tl.ActionType
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Giao nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Chỉnh sửa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Báo cáo % tiến độ'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Trả lại nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Gửi ý kiến xử lý'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Kết thúc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Chuyển xử lý'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 13 THEN 'Yêu cầu báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 14 THEN 'Gửi báo cáo'
        WHEN 15 THEN 'Xóa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 16 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 17 THEN 'Duyệt xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 18 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 19 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 20 THEN 'Từ chối xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 21 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 22 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 23 THEN 'Thu hồi xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 24 THEN 'Báo cáo lộ trình triển khai'
        WHEN 25 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 26 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 27 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 28 THEN 'Được tạo bởi AI bóc tách nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Khác'
    END                                                     AS ten_action_type,

    tl.Content                                              AS noi_dung,
    COALESCE(tl.ActionDate, tl.CreatedDate)                 AS action_date,
    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_timeline` tl

INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t
        ON t.TaskId = tl.TaskId

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_action
       ON u_action.eGovUserId = tl.UserId

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = tl.CreateUser

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = tl.TargetUserId

WHERE
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        /* TH1: AssignDepartment = '490.698.1310.1496' giao đi */
        t.AssignDepartment = '490.698.1310.1496'

        OR

        /* TH2: Trục khác giao sang (Nhận) */
        (
            /* Giao trực tiếp */
            t.TargetDepartment = '490.698.1310.1496'

            OR

            /* Giao cấp con -> check log trong qlnv_task_user */
            (
                t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310.1496.%'
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_user` tu
                    WHERE tu.TaskId = t.TaskId
                      AND tu.DepartmentId = '490.698.1310.1496'
                )
            )
        )
    )

/* GOM NHÓM THEO TIMELINEID ĐỂ KHỬ TRÙNG KHÓA CHÍNH */
GROUP BY tl.TimelineId;

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_kdnv_sontay (
    /* 1. Khóa & Nhiệm vụ */
    task_id,
    ma_nhiem_vu,
    ten_nhiem_vu,
    status,

    /* 2. Văn bản & Nhóm nhiệm vụ */
    resolution_group_id,
    ten_nhom_nhiem_vu,
    resolution_id,
    so_van_ban,
    ten_van_ban,
    ngay_ban_hanh,
    thang_ban_hanh,
    nam_ban_hanh,

    /* 3. Nguồn giao & Vai trò */
    id_nguon_nhiem_vu,
    nguon_giao_nhiem_vu,
    nguon_nhiem_vu,
    vai_tro_don_vi,

    /* 4. Đơn vị và Cán bộ */
    id_don_vi_giao,
    ten_don_vi_giao,
    id_can_bo_giao,
    ten_can_bo_giao,
    id_don_vi_thuc_hien,
    ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,
    id_chuyen_vien,
    ten_chuyen_vien,

    /* 5. Tiến độ & Mốc thời gian */
    ngay_giao,
    han_xu_ly,
    ngay_hoan_thanh,
    ngay_phe_duyet,
    ngay_tao,
    ngay_xoa,

    /* 6. Tình trạng & Kết quả */
    tinh_trang,
    so_ngay_qua_han,
    tinh_hinh_ket_qua,
    sync_date
)


SELECT 
    /* 1. THÔNG TIN KHÓA & NHIỆM VỤ (TASK) */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    t.Status                                                AS status,

    /* 2. THÔNG TIN VĂN BẢN & NHÓM NHIỆM VỤ */
    rg.ResolutionGroupId                                    AS resolution_group_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(rg.Name, ''))                           AS ten_nhom_nhiem_vu,
    r.ResolutionId                                          AS resolution_id,
    COALESCE(r.DocCode, '—')         AS so_van_ban,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(r.Compendium, ''))                      AS ten_van_ban,
    DATE_FORMAT(r.StartDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')       AS ngay_ban_hanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(r.StartDate, 'T%c')                     AS thang_ban_hanh,
    YEAR(r.StartDate)                                       AS nam_ban_hanh,

    /* 3. NGUỒN GIAO & VAI TRÒ ĐƠN VỊ */
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_nguon_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(d_assign_cap2.name)           AS nguon_giao_nhiem_vu,
    NULL                                                    AS nguon_nhiem_vu,
    CASE 
        WHEN t.ParentId IS NULL OR t.ParentId = 0     THEN 'Chủ trì'
        ELSE 'Phối hợp'
    END                                                     AS vai_tro_don_vi,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ VÀ CÁN BỘ GIAO / NHẬN */
    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_giao,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), d_assign.name) AS ten_don_vi_giao,
    t.AssignUser                                            AS id_can_bo_giao,
    u_assign.eGovUserFullname                               AS ten_can_bo_giao,

    t.TargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_thuc_hien,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.ResponsibleUnit, ''),
        NULLIF(t.TargetOrganization, ''),
        d_target.name
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,
    t.TargetUser                                            AS id_chuyen_vien,
    u_target.eGovUserFullname                               AS ten_chuyen_vien,

    /* 5. TIẾN ĐỘ & CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')     AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')      AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')   AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ApprovedDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')    AS ngay_phe_duyet,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CreatedDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')     AS ngay_tao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')     AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 6. PHÂN LOẠI TÌNH TRẠNG & SỐ NGÀY QUÁ HẠN */
    CASE
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL 
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4) 
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2) 
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL 
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Đang TH trong hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2) 
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL 
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE() 
        THEN 'Đang TH quá hạn'

        ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    CASE 
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2) 
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL 
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE() 
        THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), DATE(t.ExpireDate))
        ELSE 0 
    END                                                     AS so_ngay_qua_han,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT rp.Content 
            FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        t.Content
    )                                                       AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua,

    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t

/* Ghép văn bản / nghị quyết */
LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r
       ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
      AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* Ghép nhóm văn bản */
LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg
       ON rg.ResolutionGroupId = r.ResolutionGroupId
      AND rg.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* Tên đơn vị cấp 2 trục giao */
LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.department d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) 
            AS UNSIGNED
          )
      AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

/* Tên phòng ban giao */
LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.department d_assign
       ON d_assign.id = CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
      AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0

/* Tên phòng ban nhận */
LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.department d_target
       ON d_target.id = CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
      AND d_target.IsDelete = 0

/* Ghép user */
LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u_assign 
       ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.AssignUser

LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u_target 
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

WHERE 
    t.DeletedDate IS NULL
    AND t.Status <> 5
    AND (
        /* TH1: AssignDepartment = '490.698.1310.1496' giao đi */
        t.AssignDepartment = '490.698.1310.1496'

        OR

        /* TH2: Trục khác giao sang (Nhận) */
        (
            /* Giao trực tiếp */
            t.TargetDepartment = '490.698.1310.1496'

            OR

            /* Giao cấp con -> check log trong qlnv_task_user */
            (
                t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310.1496.%'
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
                    WHERE tu.TaskId = t.TaskId
                      AND tu.DepartmentId = '490.698.1310.1496'
                )
            )
        )
    );

Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

File Size.name: File Size

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile that is generated will be unique. If false, a random value will be generated and all FlowFiles will get the same content but this offers much higher throughput

generate-ff-custom-text.name: generate-ff-custom-text
generate-ff-custom-text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. Finally, if Expression Language is used, evaluation will be performed only once per batch of generated FlowFiles

mime-type.name: mime-type
mime-type.description: Specifies the value to set for the "mime.type" attribute.

SET SESSION group_concat_max_len = 1048576;

/* 11/11 real-time: READ COMMITTED để INSERT…SELECT đọc snapshot, không khóa S bảng nguồn */
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_bcd57 (
    resolution_group_id,
    resolution_id,
    task_id,

    nhom_nhiem_vu,
    stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi,
    van_ban_giao,
    task_title,
    noi_dung_nhiem_vu,

    don_vi_giao,
    don_vi_giao_path,

    don_vi_chu_tri,
    don_vi_chu_tri_path,

    lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien_sdt,

    assign_user_id,
    target_user_id,
    charge_user_id,
    follow_user_id,

    ngay_bat_dau,
    ngay_het_han,

    status,
    tinh_trang,

    tien_do,
    ngay_hoan_thanh,
    ngay_phe_duyet,

    tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    report_id,
    report_progress,
    report_status,
    report_updated_date,

    ld_ubnd_tp,
    ld_van_phong,
    phong_chuyen_mon,
    chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi
)


SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        r.ResolutionGroupId AS resolution_group_id,
        r.ResolutionId      AS resolution_id,
        t.TaskId            AS task_id,

        /* 1. Nhóm nhiệm vụ */
        t.NameGroup AS nhom_nhiem_vu,

        /* 2. STT nhiệm vụ theo dõi */
        t.Code AS stt_nhiem_vu_theo_doi,

        /* 3. Văn bản giao */
        t.DocCode AS van_ban_giao,

        /* Title task */
        t.Title AS task_title,

        /* 4. Nội dung nhiệm vụ */
        t.Compendium AS noi_dung_nhiem_vu,

        /* 5. Đơn vị giao */
        assign_dept.name   AS don_vi_giao,
        t.AssignDepartment AS don_vi_giao_path,

        /* =====================================================
           6. ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ (ĐẨY LÊN 1 CẤP CHO NHÁNH 490.698.752.%)
           ===================================================== */
        target_dept.name AS don_vi_chu_tri,
        
        -- Path đơn vị chủ trì sau khi đẩy cấp
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%' THEN
                CASE 
                    -- 5 cấp (4 dấu chấm) -> Đẩy lên cấp 4
                    WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    -- 4 cấp (3 dấu chấm) -> Đẩy lên cấp 3 (490.698.752)
                    WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) = 3 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
                    ELSE t.TargetDepartment
                END
            -- Các nhánh khác: 5 cấp thì lấy cấp 4
            WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
            THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
            ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
        END AS don_vi_chu_tri_path,

        /* =====================================================
           7. LÃNH ĐẠO ĐƠN VỊ + CHUYÊN VIÊN
           ===================================================== */
        /* Gom lãnh đạo đơn vị + chuyên viên thuộc UBND (490.698), giới hạn trong
           đơn vị chủ trì hoặc cấp dưới của nó. Ưu tiên phòng ban THẬT của user. */
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(
                           DISTINCT NULLIF(
                               TRIM(
                                   CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                                       NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserPositionName), ''),
                                       NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''),
                                       NULLIF(TRIM(u.PhoneNumber), '')
                                   )
                               ), ''
                           )
                           ORDER BY tu.Role, u.eGovUserFullname
                           SEPARATOR ', '
                       )
                FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
                INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u
                    ON u.eGovUserId = tu.UserId
                WHERE tu.TaskId = t.TaskId
                  AND (
                         COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) = '490.698'
                      OR COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) LIKE '490.698.%'
                      )
                  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) LIKE CONCAT(
                          CASE 
                    WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%' THEN
                        CASE 
                            WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                            THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                            WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) = 3 
                            THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
                            ELSE t.TargetDepartment
                        END
                    WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
                END,
                          '%'
                      )
            ),
            NULLIF(COALESCE(u_charge.eGovUserFullname, t.ChargeUser), ''),
            NULLIF(COALESCE(u_target.eGovUserFullname, t.TargetUser), '')
        ) AS lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien_sdt,

        /* ID user đối chiếu */
        t.AssignUser AS assign_user_id,
        t.TargetUser AS target_user_id,
        t.ChargeUser AS charge_user_id,
        t.FollowUser AS follow_user_id,

        /* 8. Ngày bắt đầu */
        t.StartedDate AS ngay_bat_dau,

        /* 9. Ngày hết hạn */
        t.ExpireDate AS ngay_het_han,

        /* Status gốc */
        t.Status AS status,

        /* 10. Tình trạng */
        CASE
            /* =======================================================================
               NHÓM 1: NHIỆM VỤ THƯỜNG XUYÊN / ĐỊNH KỲ (IsRecurring = 1)
               ======================================================================= */
            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1 
                 AND t.Status IN (3, 4)
            THEN 'Thường xuyên - Đã báo cáo'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1 
                 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
            THEN 'Thường xuyên - Chưa báo cáo'

            /* =======================================================================
               NHÓM 2: NHIỆM VỤ THƯỜNG (IsRecurring = 0)
               ======================================================================= */
            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0
                 AND t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND (
                     t.ExpireDate IS NULL
                     OR (
                         COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
                         AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
                     )
                 )
            THEN 'Hoàn thành đúng hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0
                 AND t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) > DATE(t.ExpireDate)
            THEN 'Hoàn thành quá hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0
                 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND (
                     t.ExpireDate IS NULL
                     OR DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
                 )
            THEN 'Đang thực hiện trong hạn'

            WHEN COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 0
                 AND t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
            THEN 'Đang thực hiện quá hạn'

            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS tinh_trang,

        /* Tiến độ */
        t.Progress AS tien_do,

        /* Ngày hoàn thành */
        t.CompletedDate AS ngay_hoan_thanh,

        /* Ngày phê duyệt */
        t.ApprovedDate AS ngay_phe_duyet,

        /* 11. Tình hình, kết quả thực hiện */
        rp.Content AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua_thuc_hien,

        /* Report gần nhất */
        rp.ReportId    AS report_id,
        rp.Progress    AS report_progress,
        rp.Status      AS report_status,
        rp.UpdatedDate AS report_updated_date,

        /* =====================================================
           4 CỘT LÃNH ĐẠO / THEO DÕI VĂN PHÒNG & PHÒNG CHUYÊN MÔN
           ===================================================== */
        /* LÃNH ĐẠO UBND TP: đúng đích danh cấp '490.698', chức danh Lãnh đạo, Level = 2.
           Chức vụ hiển thị: ông Vũ Đại Thắng = 'Chủ tịch', còn lại = 'Phó Chủ tịch' */
        (
            SELECT
                NULLIF(
                    TRIM(
                        CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                            CASE
                                WHEN TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname) LIKE '%Vũ Đại Thắng%' THEN 'Chủ tịch'
                                ELSE 'Phó Chủ tịch'
                            END,
                            NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), '')
                        )
                    ), ''
                )
            FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
            INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u
                ON u.eGovUserId = tu.UserId
            WHERE tu.TaskId = t.TaskId
              AND COALESCE(NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, ''), u.DepartmentPath) = '490.698'
              AND LOWER(u.eGovUserPositionName) LIKE '%lãnh đạo%'
              AND u.eGovUserPositionLevel = 2
            ORDER BY tu.Role DESC, tu.Id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ld_ubnd_tp,

        /* LÃNH ĐẠO VĂN PHÒNG:
           - Check qlnv_task_user của nhiệm vụ, nếu có user thuộc ban LIKE '490.698.752%' thì lấy user đó
           - Ưu tiên phòng ban thật của user (u.DepartmentPath), fallback tu.DepartmentId */
        (
            SELECT
                NULLIF(
                    TRIM(
                        CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                            NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserPositionName), ''),
                            NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), '')
                        )
                    ), ''
                )
            FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu
            INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u
                ON u.eGovUserId = tu.UserId
            WHERE tu.TaskId = t.TaskId
              AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '')) LIKE '490.698.752'
            ORDER BY tu.Role DESC, tu.Id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ld_van_phong,

        /* PHÒNG CHUYÊN MÔN THEO DÕI: phòng của chuyên viên VP theo dõi (CreateUser thuộc '490.698.752%') */
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(t.CreateUserDepartment, ''), u_create.DepartmentPath) LIKE '490.698.752%'
            THEN COALESCE(
                     NULLIF(d_create.name, ''),
                     NULLIF(t.CreateUserDepartment, '')
                 )
        END AS phong_chuyen_mon,

        /* CHUYÊN VIÊN VP THEO DÕI: lấy theo CreateUser, chỉ lấy khi thuộc '490.698.752%' */
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(t.CreateUserDepartment, ''), u_create.DepartmentPath) LIKE '490.698.752%'
            THEN NULLIF(u_create.eGovUserFullname, '')
        END AS chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi

    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r

    INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_resolution tr
        ON tr.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId

    /* JOIN BẢNG TASK */
    INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t
        ON t.TaskId = tr.TaskId
       AND t.Status <> 5
       AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL

    /* NGƯỜI TẠO NHIỆM VỤ (dùng cho phòng chuyên môn & chuyên viên VP theo dõi) */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u_create
        ON u_create.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser

    /* PHÒNG BAN CỦA NGƯỜI TẠO (chống CAST chuỗi rỗng) */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.department d_create
        ON d_create.id = CASE
             WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                      COALESCE(NULLIF(t.CreateUserDepartment, ''), u_create.DepartmentPath),
                      '.', -1
                  ) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
             THEN CAST(
                      SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                          COALESCE(NULLIF(t.CreateUserDepartment, ''), u_create.DepartmentPath),
                          '.', -1
                      ) AS UNSIGNED
                  )
             ELSE NULL
           END
       AND d_create.IsDelete = 0

    /* Join User dự phòng */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u_charge
        ON u_charge.eGovUserId = t.ChargeUser
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user u_target
        ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

    /* Đơn vị giao */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.department assign_dept
        ON assign_dept.id = CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)

    /* =============================================================
       ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ: MAP THEO ID CỦA PATH ĐÃ ĐẨY CẤP
       ============================================================= */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.department target_dept
        ON target_dept.id = CAST(
            SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%' THEN
                        CASE 
                            WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                            THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                            WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) = 3 
                            THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
                            ELSE t.TargetDepartment
                        END
                    WHEN (LENGTH(t.TargetDepartment) - LENGTH(REPLACE(t.TargetDepartment, '.', ''))) >= 4 
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE t.TargetDepartment 
                END,
                '.',
                -1
            ) AS UNSIGNED
        )

    /* Báo cáo gần nhất */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp
        ON rp.ReportId = (
            SELECT rp2.ReportId
            FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp2
            WHERE rp2.TaskId = t.TaskId
              AND rp2.DeletedDate IS NULL
            ORDER BY
                COALESCE(rp2.UpdatedDate, rp2.CreatedDate) DESC,
                rp2.ReportId DESC
            LIMIT 1
        )

    WHERE r.ResolutionGroupId = 55
      AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL

      /* ==========================================================
          LOGIC LẤY TASK: CHECK TARGETDEPARTMENT LIKE '490.698.752.%'
          VÀ BẮT BUỘC PHẢI CÓ LOG DepartmentId = '490.698.752'
          ========================================================== */
      AND (
          /* Nhánh giao */
          t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698%'
          
          OR 
          
          /* Nhánh nhận trực tiếp của UBND TP */
          t.TargetDepartment = '490.698'
          
          OR
          
          /* Nhánh nhận thuộc các phòng ban của Văn phòng (490.698.752.%) */
          (
              t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%'
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu_chk
                  WHERE tu_chk.TaskId = t.TaskId
                    AND tu_chk.DepartmentId = '490.698.752'
              )
          )
          
          OR
          
          /* Nhánh nhận qua UBND TP chung */
          (
              t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
              AND t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.752.%'
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_user tu_chk
                  WHERE tu_chk.TaskId = t.TaskId
                    AND tu_chk.DepartmentId = '490.698'
              )
          )
      )
) x
WHERE x.tinh_trang <> 'Chưa xác định';

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

File Size.name: File Size
File Size.description: The size of the file that will be used

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The number of FlowFiles to be transferred in each invocation

Data Format.name: Data Format
Data Format.description: Specifies whether the data should be Text or Binary

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile that is generated will be unique. If false, a random value will be generated and all FlowFiles will get the same content but this offers much higher throughput

generate-ff-custom-text.name: generate-ff-custom-text
generate-ff-custom-text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. Finally, if Expression Language is used, evaluation will be performed only once per batch of generated FlowFiles

character-set.name: character-set
character-set.description: Specifies the character set to use when writing the bytes of Custom Text to a flow file.

mime-type.name: mime-type
mime-type.description: Specifies the value to set for the "mime.type" attribute.

relationships.description: FlowFiles that have been successfully processed are routed to this relationship. This includes both FlowFiles that had text replaced and those that did not.
