/* 11/11 real-time: READ COMMITTED để INSERT…SELECT đọc snapshot, không khóa S bảng nguồn */
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_lichsutiendo_bcd57` (
    `timeline_id`,
    `task_id`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,

    `nguoi_xu_ly_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_name`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name`,

    `nguoi_nhan_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_name`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id`,
    `nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name`,

    `role`,
    `action_type`,
    `ten_action_type`,

    `noi_dung`,
    `action_date`,
    `sync_date`
)


SELECT
    tl.TimelineId                                           AS timeline_id,
    tl.TaskId                                               AS task_id,
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,

    COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser)                      AS nguoi_xu_ly_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_action.fullname, ''),
        NULLIF(u_create.fullname, ''),
        CAST(COALESCE(tl.UserId, tl.CreateUser) AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_name,

    COALESCE(u_action.position_id, u_create.position_id)    AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_action.position_name, ''),
        NULLIF(u_create.position_name, '')
    )                                                       AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name,

    tl.TargetUserId                                         AS nguoi_nhan_id,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_target.fullname, ''),
        CAST(tl.TargetUserId AS CHAR)
    )                                                       AS nguoi_nhan_name,

    u_target.position_id                                    AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,
    NULLIF(u_target.position_name, '')                      AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

    tl.Role                                                 AS role,
    tl.ActionType                                           AS action_type,

    /* Map Description từ Enum Notification */
    CASE tl.ActionType
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Giao nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Chỉnh sửa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Báo cáo % tiến độ'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo công việc'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Trả lại nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Gửi ý kiến xử lý'
        WHEN 8 THEN 'Xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'Kết thúc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 11 THEN 'Chuyển xử lý'
        WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 13 THEN 'Yêu cầu báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 14 THEN 'Gửi báo cáo'
        WHEN 15 THEN 'Xóa nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 16 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 17 THEN 'Duyệt xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 18 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 19 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo tiến độ'
        WHEN 20 THEN 'Từ chối xin gia hạn nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN 21 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 22 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo hoàn thành'
        WHEN 23 THEN 'Thu hồi xin gia hạn'
        WHEN 24 THEN 'Báo cáo lộ trình triển khai'
        WHEN 25 THEN 'Duyệt báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 26 THEN 'Từ chối báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 27 THEN 'Thu hồi báo cáo lộ trình'
        WHEN 28 THEN 'Được tạo bởi AI bóc tách nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Khác'
    END                                                     AS ten_action_type,

    tl.Content                                              AS noi_dung,
    COALESCE(tl.ActionDate, tl.CreatedDate)                 AS action_date,
    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_timeline` tl
        ON tl.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* DANH BẠ USER ĐÃ KHỬ TRÙNG eGovUserId - CHỈ GIỮ 4 CỘT CẦN DÙNG.
   Nhờ vậy 3 LEFT JOIN dưới đây không thể nhân dòng, bỏ được GROUP BY ở ngoài. */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS fullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS position_id,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS position_name
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user`
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_action
       ON u_action.eGovUserId = tl.UserId

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS fullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS position_id,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS position_name
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user`
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = tl.CreateUser

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS fullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS position_id,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS position_name
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user`
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_target
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = tl.TargetUserId

/* ĐIỀU KIỆN LẤY TASK: đồng bộ với qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_bcd57 */
WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
  AND t.Status <> 5

  /* Tương đương x.tinh_trang <> 'Chưa xác định' bên chitiet */
  AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
       OR (t.Status IN (3, 4)
           AND (   COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1
                OR t.ExpireDate IS NULL
                OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))

  /* Task thuộc nghị quyết nhóm 55 (qua qlnv_task_resolution).
     Dùng EXISTS thay vì JOIN để 1 task nằm ở nhiều nghị quyết không nhân dòng timeline. */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_resolution` tr
      INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
              ON r.ResolutionId = tr.ResolutionId
      WHERE tr.TaskId = t.TaskId
        AND r.ResolutionGroupId = 55
        AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL
  )

  AND (
      /* Nhánh giao */
      t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698%'

      OR

      /* Nhánh nhận trực tiếp của UBND TP */
      t.TargetDepartment = '490.698'

      OR

      /* Nhánh nhận thuộc các phòng ban của Văn phòng (490.698.752.%) */
      (
          t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%'
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_user` tu_chk
              WHERE tu_chk.TaskId = t.TaskId
                AND tu_chk.DepartmentId = '490.698.752'
          )
      )

      OR

      /* Nhánh nhận qua UBND TP chung */
      (
          t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
          AND t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.752.%'
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_user` tu_chk
              WHERE tu_chk.TaskId = t.TaskId
                AND tu_chk.DepartmentId = '490.698'
          )
      )
  )
;

/* 11/11 real-time: READ COMMITTED để INSERT…SELECT đọc snapshot, không khóa S bảng nguồn */
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_chitiet_bcd57` (
    `task_id`,
    `status`,
    `id_truc_giao`,
    `truc_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `chu_de`,
    `id_don_vi_giao`,
    `don_vi_giao`,
    `id_nguoi_giao`,
    `nguoi_giao`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_thuc_hien`,
    `id_nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `ngay_chap_nhan`,
    `ngay_xoa`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `ket_qua_thuc_hien`,
    `kho_khan_vuong_mac`,
    `de_xuat_kien_nghi`,
    `sync_date`
)

SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    t.Status                                                AS status,

    /* 2. TRỤC GIAO & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2)             AS id_truc_giao,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), d_assign_cap2.name) AS truc_giao,
    t.DocCode                                               AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ, TIÊU ĐỀ & CHỦ ĐỀ */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.NameGroup, ''), 'Chưa phân loại')     AS chu_de,

    /* ĐƠN VỊ GIAO & NGƯỜI GIAO */
    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_giao,
    COALESCE(d_assign.name, NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, '')) AS don_vi_giao,
    t.AssignUser                                            AS id_nguoi_giao,
    u_assign.eGovUserFullname                               AS nguoi_giao,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ & NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN */
    t.TargetDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.ResponsibleUnit, ''), 
        NULLIF(t.TargetOrganization, ''), 
        d_cap.name,
        d_donvi.name
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    
    COALESCE(
        d_donvi.name,
        NULLIF(t.ResponsibleUnit, ''),
        NULLIF(t.TargetOrganization, '')
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,

    t.TargetUser                                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
    u_target.eGovUserFullname                               AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

    /* Lãnh đạo ban phụ trách */
    CONCAT_WS(' · ',
        COALESCE(u_target.eGovUserPositionName, NULLIF(t.ChargeUser, ''))
    )                                                       AS lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach,

    /* 5. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ApprovedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                 AS ngay_chap_nhan,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 6. PHÂN LOẠI 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
    CASE
        /* 1. Đã hoàn thành (đúng hạn hoặc quá hạn) */
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'

        /* 2. Thường xuyên (nhiệm vụ không có hạn) */
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        /* 3. Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn */
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

        /* 4. Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn */
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 7. CHI TIẾT TÌNH HÌNH & BÁO CÁO (Lấy bản ghi mới nhất) */
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT rp.Content 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        t.Content,
        '—'
    )                                                       AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT NULLIF(rp.Difficulty, '') 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS kho_khan_vuong_mac,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT NULLIF(rp.Suggestion, '') 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS de_xuat_kien_nghi,

    NOW()                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* JOIN TÊN ĐƠN VỊ TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ GIAO (BÓC TÁCH ID TỪ T.ASSIGNDEPARTMENT ĐỂ LẤY TÊN) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
       ON d_assign.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN NGƯỜI GIAO NHIỆM VỤ */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
       ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.AssignUser

/* JOIN DANH MỤC PHÒNG BAN ĐƠN VỊ NHẬN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_cap
       ON d_cap.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_cap.IsDelete = 0

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN USER NHẬN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target 
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

/* ĐIỀU KIỆN LẤY TASK: giữ nguyên logic BCĐ 57 cũ (qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_bcd57) */
WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
  AND t.Status <> 5

  /* Tương đương tinh_trang <> 'Chưa xác định' của bản cũ */
  AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
       OR (t.Status IN (3, 4)
           AND (   COALESCE(t.IsRecurring, 0) = 1
                OR t.ExpireDate IS NULL
                OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))

  /* Task thuộc nghị quyết nhóm 55 (qua qlnv_task_resolution), EXISTS để không nhân dòng */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_resolution` tr
      INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
              ON r.ResolutionId = tr.ResolutionId
      WHERE tr.TaskId = t.TaskId
        AND r.ResolutionGroupId = 55
        AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL
  )

  AND (
      /* Nhánh giao */
      t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698%'

      OR

      /* Nhánh nhận trực tiếp của UBND TP */
      t.TargetDepartment = '490.698'

      OR

      /* Nhánh nhận thuộc các phòng ban của Văn phòng (490.698.752.%) */
      (
          t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.752.%'
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_user` tu_chk
              WHERE tu_chk.TaskId = t.TaskId
                AND tu_chk.DepartmentId = '490.698.752'
          )
      )

      OR

      /* Nhánh nhận qua UBND TP chung */
      (
          t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
          AND t.TargetDepartment NOT LIKE '490.698.752.%'
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_user` tu_chk
              WHERE tu_chk.TaskId = t.TaskId
                AND tu_chk.DepartmentId = '490.698'
          )
      )
  )

GROUP BY t.TaskId;

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_lichsutiendo_banTCTW (
    timeline_id,
    task_id,
    ma_nhiem_vu,

    nguoi_xu_ly_id,
    nguoi_xu_ly_name,
    nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,
    nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name,

    nguoi_nhan_id,
    nguoi_nhan_name,
    nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,
    nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

    role,
    action_type,

    noi_dung,
    action_date
)

SELECT
    /* =====================================================
       TIMELINE / TASK
       ===================================================== */
    tl.TimelineId AS timeline_id,
    tl.TaskId     AS task_id,

    /* MÃ NHIỆM VỤ */
    t.Code        AS ma_nhiem_vu,

    /* =====================================================
       NGƯỜI XỬ LÝ
       Ưu tiên UserId
       Nếu UserId NULL thì lấy CreateUser
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        tl.UserId,
        tl.CreateUser
    ) AS nguoi_xu_ly_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_action.eGovUserFullname, ''),
        NULLIF(u_create.eGovUserFullname, ''),
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                tl.UserId,
                tl.CreateUser
            ) AS CHAR
        )
    ) AS nguoi_xu_ly_name,

    /* Vai trò / chức vụ người xử lý */
    COALESCE(
        u_action.eGovUserPositionId,
        u_create.eGovUserPositionId
    ) AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_action.eGovUserPositionName, ''),
        NULLIF(u_create.eGovUserPositionName, '')
    ) AS nguoi_xu_ly_vai_tro_name,

    /* =====================================================
       NGƯỜI NHẬN
       ===================================================== */
    tl.TargetUserId AS nguoi_nhan_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(u_target.eGovUserFullname, ''),
        CAST(tl.TargetUserId AS CHAR)
    ) AS nguoi_nhan_name,

    /* Vai trò / chức vụ người nhận */
    u_target.eGovUserPositionId
        AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_id,

    NULLIF(
        u_target.eGovUserPositionName,
        ''
    ) AS nguoi_nhan_vai_tro_name,

    /* =====================================================
       ROLE CỦA TIMELINE
       Giữ riêng, không dùng làm chức vụ
       ===================================================== */
    tl.Role AS role,

    /* =====================================================
       LOẠI HÀNH ĐỘNG
       ===================================================== */
    tl.ActionType AS action_type,

    /* =====================================================
       NỘI DUNG
       ===================================================== */
    tl.Content AS noi_dung,

    /* =====================================================
       THỜI GIAN
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        tl.ActionDate,
        tl.CreatedDate
    ) AS action_date

FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_timeline tl

/* =========================================================
   TASK
   ========================================================= */
INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t
    ON t.TaskId = tl.TaskId

/* =========================================================
   USER: qlnv_user bị trùng eGovUserId (id 0 có ~174 dòng, vài id 2-3 dòng)
   => gom 1 dòng / eGovUserId để không nhân bản timeline (Duplicate entry PRIMARY timeline_id)
   ========================================================= */
/* =========================================================
   USER THỰC HIỆN ACTION
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS eGovUserFullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS eGovUserPositionId,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS eGovUserPositionName
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_action
    ON u_action.eGovUserId = tl.UserId

/* =========================================================
   USER TẠO TIMELINE
   fallback khi tl.UserId NULL
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS eGovUserFullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS eGovUserPositionId,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS eGovUserPositionName
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_create
    ON u_create.eGovUserId = tl.CreateUser

/* =========================================================
   USER NHẬN / ĐƯỢC GIAO
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname)     AS eGovUserFullname,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionId)   AS eGovUserPositionId,
        MAX(eGovUserPositionName) AS eGovUserPositionName
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) u_target
    ON u_target.eGovUserId = tl.TargetUserId

WHERE
    t.AssignDepartment LIKE '900000%'
    AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL

    /* =====================================================
       KHÔNG LẤY TASK CÓ TRẠNG THÁI "CHƯA XÁC ĐỊNH"
       ===================================================== */
    AND (
        t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)

        OR

        (
            t.Status IN (3, 4)
            AND (
                t.ExpireDate IS NULL

                OR COALESCE(
                    t.CompletedDate,
                    t.ApprovedDate
                ) IS NOT NULL
            )
        )
    );

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitietnv_banTCTW (
    task_id,
    ma_nhiem_vu,

    roadmap_id,
    thu_tu_moc,
    ten_moc,
    step_key,
    han_moc,
    han_moc_text,

    nguoi_duyet_moc_id,
    nguoi_duyet_moc_name,

    roadmap_status,
    last_report_id,
    roadmap_note,
    roadmap_created_date,
    roadmap_updated_date,

    tinh_trang_moc,
    da_bao_cao,
    tinh_trang_han_moc,

    report_id,
    report_type,
    report_status,
    report_progress,
    report_content,
    report_ket_qua,
    report_kho_khan,
    report_kien_nghi,
    report_created_date,
    report_updated_date,

    trang_thai
)

SELECT
    x.task_id,
    x.ma_nhiem_vu,

    x.roadmap_id,
    x.thu_tu_moc,
    x.ten_moc,
    x.step_key,
    x.han_moc,
    x.han_moc_text,

    x.nguoi_duyet_moc_id,
    x.nguoi_duyet_moc_name,

    x.roadmap_status,
    x.last_report_id,
    x.roadmap_note,
    x.roadmap_created_date,
    x.roadmap_updated_date,

    x.tinh_trang_moc,
    x.da_bao_cao,
    x.tinh_trang_han_moc,

    x.report_id,
    x.report_type,
    x.report_status,
    x.report_progress,
    x.report_content,
    x.report_ket_qua,
    x.report_kho_khan,
    x.report_kien_nghi,
    x.report_created_date,
    x.report_updated_date,

    x.trang_thai

FROM (
    SELECT
        /* =====================================================
           A. NHIỆM VỤ
           ===================================================== */
        t.TaskId AS task_id,
        t.Code   AS ma_nhiem_vu,

        /* =====================================================
           B. LỘ TRÌNH TRIỂN KHAI
           ===================================================== */
        roadmap.RoadmapId AS roadmap_id,
        roadmap.StepOrder AS thu_tu_moc,
        roadmap.StepName AS ten_moc,
        roadmap.StepKey AS step_key,
        roadmap.DueDate AS han_moc,
        roadmap.DueDateText AS han_moc_text,

        /* =====================================================
           C. NGƯỜI DUYỆT / PHỤ TRÁCH MỐC
           ===================================================== */
        roadmap.ApproverUserId AS nguoi_duyet_moc_id,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(roadmap_approver.eGovUserFullname, ''),
            CAST(roadmap.ApproverUserId AS CHAR)
        ) AS nguoi_duyet_moc_name,

        /* =====================================================
           D. ROADMAP
           ===================================================== */
        roadmap.Status AS roadmap_status,
        roadmap.LastReportId AS last_report_id,
        roadmap.Note AS roadmap_note,
        roadmap.CreatedDate AS roadmap_created_date,
        roadmap.UpdatedDate AS roadmap_updated_date,

        /* =====================================================
           E. ĐÃ BÁO CÁO / CHƯA BÁO CÁO
           ===================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN roadmap.RoadmapId IS NULL
            THEN NULL

            WHEN roadmap.LastReportId IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'Đã báo cáo'

            ELSE 'Chưa báo cáo'
        END AS tinh_trang_moc,

        CASE
            WHEN roadmap.LastReportId IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS da_bao_cao,

        /* =====================================================
           F. TÌNH TRẠNG HẠN MỐC
           ===================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN roadmap.DueDate IS NULL
            THEN NULL

            WHEN roadmap.LastReportId IS NULL
                 AND DATE(roadmap.DueDate) >= CURDATE()
            THEN CONCAT(
                'Còn ',
                DATEDIFF(
                    DATE(roadmap.DueDate),
                    CURDATE()
                ),
                ' ngày'
            )

            WHEN roadmap.LastReportId IS NULL
                 AND DATE(roadmap.DueDate) < CURDATE()
            THEN CONCAT(
                'Quá hạn ',
                ABS(
                    DATEDIFF(
                        DATE(roadmap.DueDate),
                        CURDATE()
                    )
                ),
                ' ngày'
            )

            ELSE 'Đã báo cáo'
        END AS tinh_trang_han_moc,

        /* =====================================================
           G. REPORT CUỐI CÙNG CỦA MỐC
           ===================================================== */
        roadmap_report.ReportId AS report_id,
        roadmap_report.Type AS report_type,
        roadmap_report.Status AS report_status,
        roadmap_report.Progress AS report_progress,
        roadmap_report.Content AS report_content,
        roadmap_report.CompletedProduct AS report_ket_qua,
        roadmap_report.Difficulty AS report_kho_khan,
        roadmap_report.Suggestion AS report_kien_nghi,
        roadmap_report.CreatedDate AS report_created_date,
        roadmap_report.UpdatedDate AS report_updated_date,

        /* =====================================================
           H. TRẠNG THÁI NHIỆM VỤ
           ===================================================== */
        CASE
            /* ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH ĐÚNG HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND COALESCE(
                        t.CompletedDate,
                        t.ApprovedDate
                     ) IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(
                        COALESCE(
                            t.CompletedDate,
                            t.ApprovedDate
                        )
                     ) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn'

            /* ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH QUÁ HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND COALESCE(
                        t.CompletedDate,
                        t.ApprovedDate
                     ) IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(
                        COALESCE(
                            t.CompletedDate,
                            t.ApprovedDate
                        )
                     ) > DATE(t.ExpireDate)
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn'

            /* ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH KHÔNG CÓ HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NULL
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành - không có hạn'

            /* CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH TRONG HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

            /* CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH QUÁ HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'

            /* CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH KHÔNG CÓ HẠN */
            WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
                 AND t.ExpireDate IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành - không có hạn'

            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS trang_thai


    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t


    /* =========================================================
       TASK -> ROADMAP
       ========================================================= */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_roadmap roadmap
        ON roadmap.TaskId = t.TaskId
       AND roadmap.DeletedDate IS NULL


    /* =========================================================
       NGƯỜI DUYỆT / PHỤ TRÁCH MỐC
       ========================================================= */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user roadmap_approver
        ON CAST(roadmap_approver.eGovUserId AS CHAR)
         = CAST(roadmap.ApproverUserId AS CHAR)


    /* =========================================================
       REPORT CUỐI CÙNG CỦA MỐC
       ========================================================= */
    LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report roadmap_report
        ON roadmap_report.ReportId = roadmap.LastReportId
       AND roadmap_report.DeletedDate IS NULL


    /* =========================================================
       TASK DO 900000 GIAO
       ========================================================= */
    WHERE
        t.AssignDepartment LIKE '900000%'
        AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL
        AND t.Status <> 5

) x

/* =========================================================
   KHÔNG INSERT NHIỆM VỤ "CHƯA XÁC ĐỊNH"
   ========================================================= */
WHERE x.trang_thai <> 'Chưa xác định';

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_banTCTW (
    task_id,
	parent_id,
	resolution_id,
	resolution_compendium,
    ma_nhiem_vu,
    ten_cap_trinh,
    ten_nhiem_vu,

    don_vi_chu_tri_id,
    don_vi_chu_tri_name,

    phong_ban_id,
    phong_ban_name,

    lanh_dao_don_vi_id,
    lanh_dao_don_vi_name,

    de_an,

    chu_de_id,
    chu_de_name,

    ld_phu_trach_id,
    ld_phu_trach_name,

    loai_van_ban_id,
    loai_van_ban_name,

    van_ban_giao,
    don_vi_phoi_hop,

    nguoi_thuc_hien_id,
    nguoi_thuc_hien_name,

    ket_qua,
    kho_khan,
    kien_nghi,

    han_hoan_thanh,
    trang_thai,

    so_bao_cao_cho_duyet,
    so_bao_cao_da_duyet,
    so_bao_cao_tu_choi,

    bao_cao_cho_duyet_gan_nhat,
    ngay_yeu_cau_bao_cao_gan_nhat
)


SELECT
    /* =====================================================
       TASK ID
       ===================================================== */
    t.TaskId AS task_id,
    t.ParentId AS parent_id,
	COALESCE(tr.ResolutionId, t.ResolutionId) AS resolution_id,
    NULLIF(r.Compendium, '')                  AS resolution_compendium,

    /* =====================================================
       MÃ NHIỆM VỤ
       ===================================================== */
    t.Code AS ma_nhiem_vu,

    /* =====================================================
       CẤP TRÌNH
       ===================================================== */
    CASE
        WHEN t.Code LIKE '%BTCTW%'
          OR t.Code LIKE '%TX%'
            THEN 'Trình Ban tổ chức Trung ương'

        WHEN t.Code LIKE '%BCT%'
            THEN 'Trình Bộ Chính trị'

        WHEN t.Code LIKE '%BBT%'
            THEN 'Trình Ban Bí thư'

        WHEN t.Code LIKE '%TW%'
            THEN 'Trình Ban chấp hành Trung ương'

        ELSE NULL
    END AS ten_cap_trinh,

    /* =====================================================
       TÊN NHIỆM VỤ
       ===================================================== */
    NULLIF(t.Title, '') AS ten_nhiem_vu,

    /* =====================================================
       ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ
       ===================================================== */
    t.TargetDepartment AS don_vi_chu_tri_id,
    target_dept.name   AS don_vi_chu_tri_name,

    /* =====================================================
       PHÒNG BAN
       ===================================================== */
    t.TargetDepartment AS phong_ban_id,
    target_dept.name   AS phong_ban_name,

    /* =====================================================
       LÃNH ĐẠO ĐƠN VỊ
       ===================================================== */
    t.AssignDepartment AS lanh_dao_don_vi_id,
    assign_dept.name   AS lanh_dao_don_vi_name,

    /* =====================================================
       ĐỀ ÁN
       ===================================================== */
    t.NameGroup AS de_an,

    /* =====================================================
       CHỦ ĐỀ
       ===================================================== */
    t.TopicId AS chu_de_id,
    t.Sector  AS chu_de_name,

    /* =====================================================
       LÃNH ĐẠO PHỤ TRÁCH
       ===================================================== */
    t.AssignUser AS ld_phu_trach_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(assign_user.eGovUserFullname, ''),
        CAST(t.AssignUser AS CHAR)
    ) AS ld_phu_trach_name,

    /* =====================================================
       LOẠI VĂN BẢN
       ===================================================== */
    file_info.loai_van_ban_id,
    file_info.loai_van_ban_name,

    /* =====================================================
       VĂN BẢN GIAO
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(t.DocCode, ''),
        NULLIF(r.DocCode, '')
    ) AS van_ban_giao,

    /* =====================================================
       ĐƠN VỊ PHỐI HỢP
       ===================================================== */
    t.ResponsibleUnit AS don_vi_phoi_hop,

    /* =====================================================
       NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN
       ===================================================== */
    t.TargetUser AS nguoi_thuc_hien_id,

    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(target_user.eGovUserFullname, ''),
        CAST(t.TargetUser AS CHAR)
    ) AS nguoi_thuc_hien_name,

    /* =====================================================
       NỘI DUNG BÁO CÁO MỚI NHẤT
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(
        NULLIF(rp.CompletedProduct, ''),
        NULLIF(rp.Content, '')
    ) AS ket_qua,

    rp.Difficulty AS kho_khan,
    rp.Suggestion AS kien_nghi,

    /* =====================================================
       HẠN HOÀN THÀNH
       ===================================================== */
    t.ExpireDate AS han_hoan_thanh,

    /* =====================================================
       TRẠNG THÁI NHIỆM VỤ
       (trường hợp 'Chưa xác định' đã bị loại ở WHERE)
       ===================================================== */
    CASE
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành - không có hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)) <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn'

        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn'

        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành - không có hạn'

        WHEN DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

        ELSE 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
    END AS trang_thai,

    /* =====================================================
       SỐ REPORT THEO STATUS (0 = Chờ duyệt, 1 = Đã duyệt, 2 = Từ chối)
       ===================================================== */
    COALESCE(report_stats.so_bao_cao_cho_duyet, 0) AS so_bao_cao_cho_duyet,
    COALESCE(report_stats.so_bao_cao_da_duyet, 0)  AS so_bao_cao_da_duyet,
    COALESCE(report_stats.so_bao_cao_tu_choi, 0)   AS so_bao_cao_tu_choi,

    /* =====================================================
       NỘI DUNG / NGÀY YÊU CẦU BÁO CÁO STATUS = 0 GẦN NHẤT
       ===================================================== */
    NULLIF(latest_pending_report.Content, '') AS bao_cao_cho_duyet_gan_nhat,
    latest_pending_report.CreatedDate         AS ngay_yeu_cau_bao_cao_gan_nhat

FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t

/* =========================================================
   ASSIGN DEPARTMENT
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.department assign_dept
    ON assign_dept.id = SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1)

/* =========================================================
   TARGET DEPARTMENT
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.department target_dept
    ON target_dept.id = SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1)

/* =========================================================
   ASSIGN USER / TARGET USER
   Danh bạ user đã khử trùng eGovUserId -> không nhân dòng.
   So sánh int = int trực tiếp (bỏ CAST AS CHAR để dùng được index)
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname) AS eGovUserFullname
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) assign_user
    ON assign_user.eGovUserId = t.AssignUser

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        eGovUserId,
        MAX(eGovUserFullname) AS eGovUserFullname
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_user
    GROUP BY eGovUserId
) target_user
    ON target_user.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

/* =========================================================
   TASK -> RESOLUTION (TaskResolutionId lớn nhất của task)
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        tr2.TaskId,
        MAX(tr2.TaskResolutionId) AS TaskResolutionId
    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_resolution tr2
    GROUP BY tr2.TaskId
) last_tr
    ON last_tr.TaskId = t.TaskId

LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_resolution tr
    ON tr.TaskResolutionId = last_tr.TaskResolutionId

LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r
    ON r.ResolutionId = COALESCE(tr.ResolutionId, t.ResolutionId)

/* =========================================================
   THỐNG KÊ REPORT THEO TASK - QUÉT qlnv_report 1 LẦN, lấy luôn:
   - số báo cáo theo Status (0 = Chờ duyệt, 1 = Đã duyệt, 2 = Từ chối)
   - báo cáo mới nhất: COALESCE(UpdatedDate, CreatedDate) mới nhất,
     trùng -> ReportId lớn hơn (dùng cho ket_qua, kho_khan, kien_nghi)
   - báo cáo Status = 0 gần nhất: CreatedDate mới nhất, trùng -> ReportId lớn hơn

   MySQL 5.7 không có ROW_NUMBER(): dựng khóa <yyyymmddhhmmss><ReportId 20 số>,
   MAX(khóa) rồi cắt lại ReportId từ ký tự thứ 15
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        rp_count.TaskId,

        SUM(rp_count.Status = 0) AS so_bao_cao_cho_duyet,
        SUM(rp_count.Status = 1) AS so_bao_cao_da_duyet,
        SUM(rp_count.Status = 2) AS so_bao_cao_tu_choi,

        CAST(SUBSTRING(
            MAX(CONCAT(
                COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(rp_count.UpdatedDate, rp_count.CreatedDate), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '00000000000000'),
                LPAD(rp_count.ReportId, 20, '0')
            )), 15) AS UNSIGNED) AS latest_report_id,

        CAST(SUBSTRING(
            MAX(CASE
                WHEN rp_count.Status = 0
                THEN CONCAT(
                    COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(rp_count.CreatedDate, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '00000000000000'),
                    LPAD(rp_count.ReportId, 20, '0')
                )
            END), 15) AS UNSIGNED) AS latest_pending_report_id

    FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp_count

    WHERE rp_count.DeletedDate IS NULL

    GROUP BY rp_count.TaskId

) report_stats
    ON report_stats.TaskId = t.TaskId

LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp
    ON rp.ReportId = report_stats.latest_report_id

LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report latest_pending_report
    ON latest_pending_report.ReportId = report_stats.latest_pending_report_id

/* =========================================================
   LOẠI VĂN BẢN
   ========================================================= */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        file_task.TaskId,

        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT file_task.Type
            ORDER BY file_task.Type
            SEPARATOR ', '
        ) AS loai_van_ban_id,

        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT
            CASE
                WHEN file_task.Type = 2
                    THEN 'Văn bản chỉ đạo thực hiện'

                WHEN file_task.Type = 3
                    THEN 'KH/HĐ chỉ đạo'

                WHEN file_task.Type = 4
                    THEN 'CTHĐ thực hiện'

                ELSE CONCAT(
                    'Loại ',
                    file_task.Type
                )
            END
            ORDER BY file_task.Type
            SEPARATOR ' | '
        ) AS loai_van_ban_name

    FROM (
        /* =================================================
           FILE GẮN TASK
           ================================================= */
        SELECT
            f.TaskId,
            f.Type
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_file f
        WHERE f.TaskId IS NOT NULL
          AND f.DeletedDate IS NULL
          AND f.Type IS NOT NULL

        UNION ALL

        /* =================================================
           FILE GẮN REPORT
           ================================================= */
        SELECT
            rp_file.TaskId,
            f.Type
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_file f

        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_report rp_file
            ON rp_file.ReportId = f.ReportId

        WHERE f.ReportId IS NOT NULL
          AND f.DeletedDate IS NULL
          AND f.Type IS NOT NULL

        UNION ALL

        /* =================================================
           FILE GẮN RESOLUTION
           ================================================= */
        SELECT
            tr_file.TaskId,
            f.Type
        FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_file f

        INNER JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task_resolution tr_file
            ON tr_file.ResolutionId = f.ResolutionId

        WHERE f.ResolutionId IS NOT NULL
          AND f.DeletedDate IS NULL
          AND f.Type IS NOT NULL

    ) file_task

    GROUP BY file_task.TaskId

) file_info
    ON file_info.TaskId = t.TaskId

WHERE
    t.AssignDepartment LIKE '900000%'
    AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL

    /* KHÔNG LẤY TRẠNG THÁI 'Chưa xác định'
       (lọc thẳng trên qlnv_task thay cho bọc SELECT ngoài rồi lọc x.trang_thai;
        đồng thời đã loại Status = 5) */
    AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
         OR (t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND (   t.ExpireDate IS NULL
                  OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)));

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).
